TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_MUDKIP.assessment: Treecko's Jolly physical allocation supports Seed Bomb, coverage and priority. Swords Dance offers a punish against passive preparation; Life Orb gives immediate danger. There are no reserves or partner interactions in this intentionally retained exception. Runtime starter substitution is a separate dependency, so this row establishes the Hoenn loadout only.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_MUDKIP.acceptance: Run the Hoenn Mudkip-player branch and a substituted generation; verify one opponent, legal replacement moves, and attack versus Swords Dance selection against immediate lethal pressure.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_TORCHIC.assessment: Mudkip uses Adamant physical investment and four attacks; Low Kick and Rock Slide prevent a single obvious resistance from solving all positions. Life Orb recoil matters in the one-on-one. No doubles support should be injected into this singles exception.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_TORCHIC.acceptance: Verify player Torchic dispatches Mudkip; compare Waterfall with coverage against a resistant target and record recoil plus Torrent activation.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_TREECKO.assessment: Torchic combines Life Orb Flare Blitz with Swords Dance and physical coverage. Its Jolly allocation can matter at cap 14, and recoil makes the exact finishing sequence important. The supplied team contains one Pokémon, with no reserve assumptions.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_103_TREECKO.acceptance: Verify player Treecko dispatches Torchic; exercise a fast threat and a protected setup opportunity, including recoil and Blaze thresholds.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_MUDKIP.assessment: May's Treecko branch independently matches its Brendan counterpart: physical Jolly Life Orb, setup, Grass STAB, Fighting coverage and priority. Gender selection must not alter power or introduce a second party member.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_MUDKIP.acceptance: Run May with the player Mudkip choice; confirm identical stats and action options to Brendan and one-Pokémon battle creation.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_TORCHIC.assessment: May's Mudkip retains the direct four-attack solution with Adamant physical investment. Matching the Brendan counterpart is intentional branch parity, not redundant encounter content to delete.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_TORCHIC.acceptance: Run May's Torchic-player route; confirm Mudkip's exact item, moves and level, then exercise a coverage selection and Life Orb knockout trade.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_TREECKO.assessment: May's Torchic branch preserves recoil offense and optional Swords Dance. This is already an expert opening singles puzzle; the female-rival branch needs independent dispatch validation rather than a different roster.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_103_TREECKO.acceptance: Run May's Treecko-player branch; compare its prepared stats and AI decisions with the matching Brendan fixture.

TRAINER_CALVIN_1.assessment: The Poochyena/Zigzagoon lead has real immediate and setup alternatives, with orb Taillow and Reckless Starly retaining pressure after disruption. Physical specialization is a legitimate ordinary-trainer identity. The crack text overstates half-HP vulnerability: Sitrus commonly heals immediately after Belly Drum, and Intimidate does not erase a +6 boost.
TRAINER_CALVIN_1.acceptance: Trace Belly Drum into Sitrus at actual low-level HP, Helping Hand target selection, Sucker Punch failure awareness and both reserve choices.
TRAINER_CALVIN_1.proposed_crack: Disrupt or remove Zigzagoon before Belly Drum resolves, account for its immediate Sitrus recovery, and prepare resistance or priority control for Extreme Speed. Intimidate reduces physical pressure but does not erase Belly Drum; Taillow's Guts also changes the value of status.

TRAINER_RICK.assessment: Electroweb/Toxic Thread supplies alternative speed routes for Dwebble and Karrablast; Dewpider is a substantial physical Water reserve. No Guard makes Megahorn reliable, while Sturdy and Eviolite serve different survival functions. The Fire advice misses Water Bubble Dewpider's interaction.
TRAINER_RICK.acceptance: Test Electroweb into a mixed Ground/non-Ground board, Toxic Thread selection and the Water Bubble Fire modifier when Dewpider enters.
TRAINER_RICK.proposed_crack: Ground immunity and Taunt disrupt different Spinarak options. Special attacks can bypass the Rock/Bug members' physical bulk, but Dewpider's Water Bubble substantially changes Fire damage and its own Water threat; choose attacks for the active pair.

TRAINER_ALLEN.assessment: Pikachu's Fake Out opens Paras's Spore or Reflect, with Slakoth supplying high immediate damage between Truant turns. Huge Power Bunnelby keeps reserve pressure practical. Dry Skin introduces Water absorption and Fire vulnerability; Lightning Rod and powder immunities make target selection critical.
TRAINER_ALLEN.acceptance: Verify Fake Out supports a legal Spore target, no Spore into Grass/Goggles, and Slakoth action tracking after a player Protect.

TRAINER_TIANA.assessment: Skitty supplies Fake Out, Helping Hand and Sing for offensive Swirlix; Eevee and Taillow give independent physical reserves. Sing's inaccuracy is an authored risk, not proof of failure. Sitrus consumption and Unburden need actual HP/speed validation; priority is not an unconditional knockout.
TRAINER_TIANA.acceptance: Exercise Sitrus-triggered Unburden at the exact cap, support versus protected opponents, and Taillow selection against a Fairy-resistant board.
TRAINER_TIANA.proposed_crack: Steel and Poison resist Swirlix's Fairy attack but must account for coverage. Taunt limits Sing and Helping Hand, while damage or priority can finish Swirlix depending on actual HP and investment after Sitrus recovery.

TRAINER_BILLY.assessment: Lotad's rain enables Wingull's Hurricane accuracy and both Water attacks, with Scarf Imposter and Wide Lens Tandemaus offering distinct reserves. The actual order begins with manual rain, so the AI must value setup when it changes this turn's damage and speed. Ditto copies only its target, not the whole opposing strategy.
TRAINER_BILLY.acceptance: Record rain timing, Hurricane accuracy, Ditto transformation/Choice lock and Encore when Tandemaus replaces a fallen lead.

TRAINER_DARIAN.assessment: Chinchou supports a bulky Dragon Dance Barboach with paralysis; Choice Band Corphish and Deep Sea Tooth Clamperl create credible immediate versus setup reserve decisions. The entire roster has a Grass vulnerability, but shared habitat and complementary offensive routes make this a defensible specialized puzzle.
TRAINER_DARIAN.acceptance: Compare Thunder Wave against immediate damage; test Clamperl Shell Smash under lethal pressure and priority Corphish replacement.

TRAINER_CINDY_1.assessment: Intimidate and Aroma Veil help the support lead; Furfrou's Fur Coat and specially invested bulk make its Cotton Guard plan coherent. Slakoth adds burst damage between loafing turns. Aroma Veil means blanket Taunt advice is wrong while Milcery is active.
TRAINER_CINDY_1.acceptance: Test Aroma Veil protection of both battlers, Furfrou recovery-free durability, and Slakoth Truant tracking after switching.
TRAINER_CINDY_1.proposed_crack: Special attacks avoid Furfrou's Fur Coat benefit, while Steel and Poison threaten the Fairy pair. Remove or suppress Aroma Veil before relying on Taunt against protected allies, and exploit Slakoth's known Truant turns.

TRAINER_LYLE.assessment: Nymble's First Impression and Tinted Lens supply immediate pressure beside Sewaddle's damage reduction. Karrablast adds accurate heavy damage; Shuckle converts slow bulk into Rock Tomb, Encore and Helping Hand. A low-profile bug collection is already strategically complete.
TRAINER_LYLE.acceptance: Test First Impression only on valid entry turns, priority versus Protect and Shuckle support of the remaining attacker.

TRAINER_GRUNT_PETALBURG_WOODS.assessment: Carvanha Protect and Wailmer's Icy Wind create a meaningful speed choice while Water Spout rewards preserving HP. Grimer and Poochyena preserve faction identity while supplying item removal, priority and Snarl. No early-grunt simplification is justified.
TRAINER_GRUNT_PETALBURG_WOODS.acceptance: Compare Water Spout scores before/after damage, Speed Boost after Protect and Poochyena Helping Hand versus Snarl by partner and target.

TRAINER_JAMES_1.assessment: Surskit enables rain and slows replacement opponents through Web; Venipede can use Protect for Speed Boost. Dewpider and Technician Kricketune keep the remaining pair dangerous. Hazards compete with immediate attacks in four-versus-six doubles and should be situational rather than forced.
TRAINER_JAMES_1.acceptance: Test Web value with two versus zero opposing reserves, rain supporting Dewpider, and no repeated Toxic Spikes at full layers.

TRAINER_WINSTON_1.assessment: Porygon/Honedge combines special coverage with physical setup, while Gimmighoul and Wooloo provide distinct reserves. The roster is sound, but Ace Pokemon locks last-slot Wooloo rather than the Gimmighoul named in the plan. Preserve the actual positional choice and correct the explanation unless battle evidence later favors a reorder.
TRAINER_WINSTON_1.acceptance: Verify Wooloo is the final locked ace; exercise Honedge setup under pressure and Gimmighoul Substitute only when its HP permits.

TRAINER_HALEY_1.assessment: Eevee's Wish and Adaptability attacks pair with Ralts's paralysis and special pressure. Marill adds powerful priority and Snubbull Intimidate, so the claim that any physical attacker walks through both ignores reserve support and preparation. Preserve the team, qualify counterplay.
TRAINER_HALEY_1.acceptance: Test Wish healing the correct slot after replacement, Trace behavior, and reserve Intimidate into Defiant or Clear Amulet.
TRAINER_HALEY_1.proposed_crack: Apply immediate pressure to fragile Ralts while respecting Focus Sash and paralysis. Fighting pressures Eevee, Ghost threatens Ralts, and defensive answers must also account for Marill's Huge Power and Snubbull's Intimidate.

TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1.assessment: Plusle/Minun has authentic paired-ability offense and disruption. Volbeat's pass route only works when an eligible recipient remains in reserve; if Illumise is already active it cannot be the Baton Pass recipient. Preserve the four members and make this conditional interaction explicit.
TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1.acceptance: Trace Plus/Minus after a knockout, Baton Pass with Illumise benched versus active, and no boost-passing action without a legal useful receiver.
TRAINER_GINA_AND_MIA_1.proposed_crack: Ground answers the Electric lead but must respect Charm and Encore. Disrupt Volbeat's Tail Glow or its legal Baton Pass recipient; Illumise can receive the boost only while in reserve, and Bug/Fairy coverage remains relevant after the Electric pair falls.

TRAINER_IVAN.assessment: Tentacool's Acid Spray and Icy Wind can support Clamperl's massive special output; Chewtle supplies physical coverage and Chinchou an Electric immunity. Deep Sea Tooth and Shell Smash are intentional high-threat tools, not a reason to tone down an ordinary fisherman.
TRAINER_IVAN.acceptance: Compare Acid Spray plus partner damage with two attacks, verify Smash/White-Herb absence and do not aim Electric at Volt Absorb.
TRAINER_IVAN.proposed_crack: Interrupt Clamperl's Shell Smash or attack its reduced defenses afterward, but calculate damage rather than assuming a knockout. Chinchou's Volt Absorb makes blanket Electric coverage unsafe once it enters.

TRAINER_CYNDY_1.assessment: Prankster Riolu Coaching directly improves Pure Power Meditite, with Iron Fist Crabrawler and Technician Clobbopus extending physical pressure. Fake Out and Feint allow different lines around Protect. This is a coherent cap-14 advanced puzzle worth retaining.
TRAINER_CYNDY_1.acceptance: Confirm Coaching affects the partner, Fake Out creates a genuine action window and Feint opens a protected target for the second attack.

TRAINER_HECTOR.assessment: Zangoose/Seviper preserves Hoenn rival-species identity with mixed damage; Spinda's Fake Out/Encore and Porygon's Download avoid a one-dimensional reserve pair. Toxic Boost depends on orb timing, while Infiltrator changes defensive counterplay. Keep the authored composition.
TRAINER_HECTOR.acceptance: Trace orb activation and Facade damage, Infiltrator through Substitute/screens, and Spinda Encore after a revealed support move.

TRAINER_MARLENE.assessment: Spoink's Room enables Slowpoke, Baltoy and Gothita's slow spreads. Regenerator and Levitate give useful replacement choices, and Competitive punishes careless stat drops. Force Setup is acceptable only as a scoring preference; setting or reversing Room must still depend on the actual board.
TRAINER_MARLENE.acceptance: Run Trick Room with a slower opposing team and with active Room; verify no automatic reversal and useful Regenerator switching.

TRAINER_JOEY.assessment: Fake Out/Nuzzle Pawmi and Yawn Lechonk provide competing forms of disruption, followed by multihit Tandemaus or Belly Drum Zigzagoon. This is a strong ordinary composition; blanket Rock weakness is a prose error because pure Normal does not take super-effective Rock damage.
TRAINER_JOEY.acceptance: Test status selection avoiding paralysis of an intended Yawn target, Population Bomb against Helmet, and Sitrus immediately after Drum.
TRAINER_JOEY.proposed_crack: Fighting pressures the Normal members and Ground answers Pawmi. Rocky Helmet punishes Population Bomb contact, while Protect can deny its turn; account for Wide Lens and Zigzagoon's Sitrus recovery rather than relying on Rock damage alone.

TRAINER_JOSE.assessment: Dustox Tailwind enables Beautifly without requiring both partners to attack; Quiver Dance can create a threatening sweeper when support survives. Kricketune and Venipede sustain physical options and disruption. Shield Dust and Black Sludge have functional roles.
TRAINER_JOSE.acceptance: Trace Tailwind into same-turn order, Beautifly setup versus immediate KO, and Venipede Toxic Spikes with remaining enemy reserves.

TRAINER_CLARK.assessment: Roggenrola can convert Defense investment into Body Press while Geodude attacks without Earthquake friendly fire. Mudbray rewards repeated physical contact and itemless Archen gains Acrobatics power. The defense core is coherent; no special-attack immunity is implied by Stamina.
TRAINER_CLARK.acceptance: Test Iron Defense versus immediate Body Press, Stamina after multihit damage and Acrobatics at itemless power.

TRAINER_JOHNSON.assessment: Shinx's Intimidate protects Starly's recoil offense; Bunnelby and Taillow supply Huge Power and Guts reserve pressure. All-physical construction deliberately exposes the team to physical mitigation while retaining real damage. Guts makes burn an unsafe universal solution.
TRAINER_JOHNSON.acceptance: Verify U-turn preserves an Intimidate cycling opportunity, recoil knockout handling and orb reserve selection against burn-based defenses.

TRAINER_DEVAN.assessment: Hippopotas/Drilbur is a complete sand lead with Yawn and recovery supporting Sand Rush offense. Aron remains sand-safe and Cranidos provides Scarf speed outside weather. All four have usable tools; natural Grass/Water counterplay does not warrant patching every weakness.
TRAINER_DEVAN.acceptance: Test weather replacement immediately changing Drilbur order, Yawn versus existing status and Mold Breaker damage through Sturdy.

TRAINER_DAWSON.assessment: Galarian Meowth Fake Out supports Rookidee's Tailwind/Taunt; Wooloo absorbs physical pressure and the final Tandemaus is the actual locked ace. Different origins fit a collector. The Last-slot ace flag is coherent here and should remain explicit.
TRAINER_DAWSON.acceptance: Check Tailwind beneficiaries, Meowth U-turn reserve selection and final Tandemaus release only when eligible under the ace rule.

TRAINER_SARAH.assessment: Aroma Veil Spritzee establishes Room beside slow Gothita, with Fidough and Baltoy covering physical and special reserve roles. Fake Tears can enable the special partner. Taunt advice is mechanically false while Aroma Veil applies; the loadout itself is cohesive.
TRAINER_SARAH.acceptance: Test Taunt into both allies while Aroma Veil is active and removed, Fake Tears against a physical partner and Room against slower foes.
TRAINER_SARAH.proposed_crack: Pressure Spritzee directly or suppress/remove Aroma Veil before relying on Taunt. Steel and Poison pressure the Fairy members; Protect and defensive positioning can consume Trick Room turns, but Baltoy supplies Ground coverage.

TRAINER_JANICE.assessment: Pichu redirects Electric moves from Marill while Fake Out or Nuzzle enables its damage. Swirlix provides a fast special Unburden route and Chewtle physical coverage. Timid special Pichu is deliberate: Fake Out/Nuzzle are utility, not investment failures.
TRAINER_JANICE.acceptance: Test Lightning Rod shielding Marill from single-target Electric while spread interactions remain correct, and Nuzzle/Unburden speed changes.

TRAINER_JERRY_1.assessment: Magnemite/Varoom has clear industrial flavor, Sturdy plus Balloon survival and complementary special/physical attacks. Adaptability Skrelp and Grimer diversify the reserve typing. Opponent Magnemite does not by itself authorize moving the wild family out of New Mauville.
TRAINER_JERRY_1.acceptance: Trace Balloon popping before Ground damage on a later action, Sturdy at non-full HP, and Skrelp Adaptability applying only to its actual STAB types.

TRAINER_JOSH.assessment: The six-member Sturdy wall forces chip and target-order decisions immediately. Counter, Guard Split, recovery and Helping Hand prevent it being six interchangeable attackers. Dwebble's Sash/Sturdy overlap is conditional insurance against ability bypass rather than automatically obsolete.
TRAINER_JOSH.acceptance: Test Counter against physical/special damage, Guard Split effects, Mold Breaker through Sturdy with Sash still live, and recovery restoring Sturdy.

TRAINER_TOMMY.assessment: Storm Drain Lileep protects a physically offensive Anorith lead; the reserves supply speed drops, trapping, strong contact attacks and Solid Rock bulk. Nosepass is genuinely useful through Magnet Pull and special Ground/Electric coverage. Maintain exact specialty composition.
TRAINER_TOMMY.acceptance: Test Water redirection including bypassing spread moves, Magnet Pull escape exceptions and Shuckle Helping Hand when the partner Protects.

TRAINER_MARC.assessment: Snow/Aurora Veil and Power Spot/Wide Guard make a sophisticated lead; Tyrunt/Klawf provide setup pressure and Archen/Cranidos immediate finishing power. The crack incorrectly says established Veil dies with snow; snow is needed for setting it, not continued effect.
TRAINER_MARC.acceptance: Change weather after Veil is set and verify protection persists until expiry/removal; test Wide Guard against mixed spread/single-target boards.
TRAINER_MARC.proposed_crack: Replace snow before Aurora Veil is established, or remove the established screen with a valid move such as Brick Break or Defog. Ending snow afterward does not itself remove Veil. Exploit Cranidos's Choice lock and Archen's Defeatist threshold with calculated pressure.

TRAINER_ROXANNE_1.assessment: The existing Carbink/Relicanth opening, Guts Larvitar, Rock Head Sudowoodo and Bombirdier finisher already satisfy the expert-first premise. Restore iconic Nosepass in Onix's slot while preserving the other five exact loadouts and level offsets. Use a specially defensive Eviolite special attacker with Wide Guard to give the signature Pokémon a substantive partner-protection role.
TRAINER_ROXANNE_1.acceptance: Compare original/revised teams at cap 14; confirm Wide Guard protects against spread Water/Ground attacks but not single-target attacks, Sturdy survival, and Bombirdier remains final ace.

TRAINER_GRUNT_RUSTURF_TUNNEL.assessment: Mightyena/Qwilfish supplies immediate double Intimidate, with Skrelp converting Acid Spray into special pressure and Zubat avoiding flinch through Inner Focus. This retains faction identity and distinct reserve typing. Defiant/Competitive counterplay should remain a legitimate clean solution.
TRAINER_GRUNT_RUSTURF_TUNNEL.acceptance: Run Intimidate into Defiant, Competitive and Clear Amulet fixtures; ensure reserve choice does not blindly re-trigger a harmful boost.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_MUDKIP.assessment: Taillow/Electrike opens with orb damage and Lightning Rod protection. Shroomish supplies sleep while Grovyle gives immediate physical Grass pressure; its absence of setup keeps the reserve self-sufficient. Preserve all four and the actual starter mapping.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_MUDKIP.acceptance: Run Mudkip-player dispatch; test single-target Electric redirection, orb activation and Spore targeting while Grovyle is the remaining reserve.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_TORCHIC.assessment: The same protected Taillow lead is followed by Shroomish and bulky Sitrus Marshtomp. Ground immunity changes reserve selection against Electric, and Marshtomp's fourfold Grass weakness remains legitimate counterplay.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_TORCHIC.acceptance: Verify Marshtomp branch creation, reserve selection into Electric versus Grass threats, and Sitrus at actual level-adjusted HP.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_TREECKO.assessment: Combusken adds Speed Boost and Protect to the Taillow/Electrike/Shroomish core, giving the fifth-turn board a distinct speed problem. Life Orb physical allocation supports its attacks; no automatic early-power downgrade is warranted.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_RUSTBORO_TREECKO.acceptance: Verify Treecko-player dispatch; trace Speed Boost and Protect timing, and avoid Spore into powder immunity.

TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_MUDKIP.assessment: May's Grovyle branch preserves the same four prepared Pokémon as Brendan. Its Grass-heavy reserves trade some defensive overlap for Spore plus immediate Leaf Blade damage; that is a branch identity, not a global distribution defect.
TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_MUDKIP.acceptance: Independently load May's Mudkip-player branch; compare stats, redirection and final Grovyle coverage with the matching Brendan case.

TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_TORCHIC.assessment: May's Marshtomp branch has physical bulk and Ground typing in reserve alongside Shroomish support. The exact counterpart parity is sound and should remain while expanded starter substitution is audited centrally.
TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_TORCHIC.acceptance: Exercise May's correct dispatch, Lightning Rod with Marshtomp entering and reserve choice against Grass pressure.

TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_TREECKO.assessment: May's Combusken carries the same offensive Speed Boost route as Brendan. Electrike initially protects Taillow, then can pivot while Shroomish supplies sleep. This is a full dangerous doubles team rather than an introductory demonstration.
TRAINER_MAY_RUSTBORO_TREECKO.acceptance: Run May's Treecko-player route and compare Combusken speed after Protect with an invested opposing speed-control team.

TRAINER_NED.assessment: Finneon manually establishes long rain for Arrokuda; Mantyke and Tentacool supply Helping Hand, Acid Spray and Icy Wind as different reserve support choices. Water Absorb applies to Mantyke but not all teammates; no Surf friendly-fire assumption is needed.
TRAINER_NED.acceptance: Test rain-to-Liquidation timing, Finneon U-turn replacement, and Acid Spray scoring beside physical Arrokuda versus special Finneon.

TRAINER_ELLIOT_1.assessment: Clauncher/Frillish splits immediate special damage and burn/Hex sustain; Shellder and Corphish create setup versus priority reserves. White Herb restores Shellder's dropped defenses after Smash, so its alleged automatic fragility is overstated.
TRAINER_ELLIOT_1.acceptance: Verify White Herb restores defenses on Shell Smash and Shelder's five-hit moves; compare Frillish burn with Hex after existing status.
TRAINER_ELLIOT_1.proposed_crack: Grass and Electric pressure much of the roster, while Taunt limits Frillish and Shell Smash. Shellder consumes White Herb to restore its lowered defenses, so calculate the follow-up rather than assuming any priority attack knocks it out.

TRAINER_LAURA.assessment: Mienfoo/Croagunk offers two Fake Out targets and useful sustain, with Guts Timburr, Thick Fat Makuhita, Scarf Mankey and Counter Tyrogue extending the threat. Leftovers Guts Tyrogue is status insurance rather than guaranteed activation. Preserve the six prepared fighters.
TRAINER_LAURA.acceptance: Test both lead actions avoiding redundant Fake Outs on one target, Mienfoo Regenerator cycling and Mankey Defiant into Intimidate.

TRAINER_BRENDEN.assessment: Sawk is immediate Scarf pressure beside bulky Throh; Machop, Stufful, Monferno and Riolu cover confusion, setup and Coaching. The plan's Levitate reference is irrelevant because Sawk has no Ground move. Guts Throh without an orb remains a defensible status deterrent.
TRAINER_BRENDEN.acceptance: Verify No Guard Dynamic Punch and Coaching of a physical ally; test Sawk's actual Mold Breaker benefit through Sturdy.

TRAINER_LILITH.assessment: Hitmontop supports Scraggy's Moxie/Dragon Dance, with varied physical reserves retaining Fairy/Flying counterplay. Galarian Farfetch'd's Brick Break has a screen-removal purpose alongside Close Combat. Preserve this role unless empirical usage proves redundant.
TRAINER_LILITH.acceptance: Test Fake Out enabling Dragon Dance, Feint plus partner attack through Protect and Brick Break against active screens.

TRAINER_TAKAO.assessment: Grapploct/Wobbuffet creates an immediate trapping puzzle; the reserves offer Unburden, Water absorption, Scarf Defiant and priority. Octolock adds defense drops even when Shadow Tag already traps. The combination needs accurate Ghost/pivot escape rules rather than universal trapping claims.
TRAINER_TAKAO.acceptance: Test Ghost escape, damaging pivot escape, Counter/Mirror Coat target handling and White Herb activation into Unburden.

TRAINER_CRISTIAN.assessment: Beat Up Falinks can raise Justified Gallade or Lucario, but its uninvested Speed means boosting may occur after the recipient attacks on the first turn. The combo remains useful across turns; preserve it and state this timing honestly. Double Ace locks Machamp/Annihilape, leaving Lucario eligible earlier.
TRAINER_CRISTIAN.acceptance: Record Beat Up hit count, allied damage and action order at cap 20; require AI to reject lethal ally damage and to consider Coaching when more useful.

TRAINER_JOCELYN.assessment: Whimsicott/Combusken and reserve Volbeat sustain Tailwind while Breloom and Crabominable supply different speed profiles. Sirfetch'd is the genuine last-slot ace. The blanket Prankster/Dark claim is false: Dark immunity does not stop side-targeted Tailwind or screens.
TRAINER_JOCELYN.acceptance: Run Tailwind with opposing Dark types, Encore into a Dark target, Poison Heal activation and Sirfetch'd's recharge after Meteor Assault.
TRAINER_JOCELYN.proposed_crack: Dark types block opposing Prankster moves that target them, such as Encore or Thunder Wave; they do not stop Tailwind or Light Screen. Remove support, manage Tailwind turns and account for Breloom's active Poison Heal before choosing status or chip lines.

TRAINER_BRAWLY_1.assessment: Pachirisu/Heracross, Guts Conkeldurr, Fake Out Hariyama, Unburden Hawlucha and Coaching Cobalion already embody expert doubles. Iconic Hariyama is present in a substantive role. Preserve Cobalion and the full composition; its power is intentional, not a nostalgia defect.
TRAINER_BRAWLY_1.acceptance: Test Follow Me with spread moves, Quick Guard versus priority, Hawlucha White Herb/Unburden/Acrobatics and Coaching improving the active physical partner.

TRAINER_HAILEY.assessment: Flaaffy's screens and Electroweb support Marill immediately, then Tympole or White Herb Wartortle. This is a coherent mixed-damage field team. The crack understates White Herb's defensive restoration; setup need not be falsely advertised as an automatic free knockout.
TRAINER_HAILEY.acceptance: Trace screen duration, Electroweb changing partner order, White Herb after Smash and damage against protected Wartortle.
TRAINER_HAILEY.proposed_crack: Remove screens with a valid tool or pressure Flaaffy before both are established. Grass/Electric matchups remain relevant, but Wartortle's White Herb restores Shell Smash defense drops; prepare a calculated response to its boosted offense.

TRAINER_EDMOND.assessment: Neutralizing Gas deliberately disables defensive enemy abilities, but also suppresses friendly Reckless, Sheer Force and Water Absorb while Koffing remains. That trade is legitimate; the prose currently sells only the favorable half. Preserve loadouts and specify suppressed damage/absorption correctly.
TRAINER_EDMOND.acceptance: Compare Staravia recoil damage and Krabby Life Orb behavior with Koffing present/absent; verify entry abilities after Gas ends.

TRAINER_RICKY_1.assessment: Wooper's Yawn/Recover buys turns for Chewtle; Competitive Prinplup and Specs Clauncher supply stronger special reserves. Water Absorb and Grass weakness give Wooper a clear defensive niche. Shared Water identity is acceptable alongside varied roles.
TRAINER_RICKY_1.acceptance: Test Yawn against existing status and switching, Competitive reserve entry after a stat drop and Clauncher's Choice-locked pulse selection.

TRAINER_LOLA_1.assessment: Sun supports Leafeon's speed and Cherubi while Luvdisc uses configured Soul-Heart and Ferroseed punishes contact. Sun weakens Hydro Pump and worsens Ferroseed's Fire matchup, so these are conditional reserves rather than universal sun beneficiaries. Rock does not remove sunlight.
TRAINER_LOLA_1.acceptance: Test Luvdisc boosts on ally and enemy fainting, sun-modified Hydro Pump and Ferroseed entry under opposing Fire pressure.
TRAINER_LOLA_1.proposed_crack: Replace or stall sun to reduce Chlorophyll speed, or attack the active Grass pair through suitable coverage. Rock damage does not itself end sunlight. Luvdisc and Ferroseed change the matchup once they enter, including Water damage reduction and Fire vulnerability under sun.

TRAINER_CHANDLER.assessment: Hydration Phione's rain/Rest cycle and Swift Swim Buizel provide a real weather plan; Water Absorb Chinchou and Unaware Quagsire offer defensive alternatives. Aqua Jet's priority is independent of Swift Swim, while Liquidation gains the speed benefit.
TRAINER_CHANDLER.acceptance: Trace same-turn rain and speed, Hydration removing Rest sleep at the configured timing, and Unaware against boosted offense.

TRAINER_DWAYNE.assessment: Smoochum Fake Out supports Magby's special pressure or creates its own Nasty Plot opportunity, with physical Elekid and Monferno preventing a purely special team. Magby has no guaranteed burn move; Flamethrower and Flame Body are probabilistic effects.
TRAINER_DWAYNE.acceptance: Compare Smoochum Fake Out versus Nasty Plot under lethal pressure, Clear Smog into immunity and Elekid contact interactions.

TRAINER_JOHANNA.assessment: Budew sleep supports Pixilate/Throat Spray Sylveon, while Feebas and Qwilfish are distinct reserves. Adaptability boosts Feebas's Water attacks, not its non-STAB Dragon Pulse. Preserve the surprising Feebas choice but avoid advertising a nonexistent Dragon boost.
TRAINER_JOHANNA.acceptance: Test Pixilate spread Hyper Voice and Throat Spray, powder immunities and Feebas Water versus Dragon damage multipliers.

TRAINER_SIMON.assessment: Prinplup/Mudbray splits speed reduction and Stamina physical pressure, with Unaware Quagsire and Assault Vest Chinchou handling alternate matchups. The bulky roster can function without outspeeding everything; Icy Wind is useful relative control, not a universal order guarantee.
TRAINER_SIMON.acceptance: Calculate actual post-Icy-Wind order against invested targets and verify Stamina/Unaware affect the correct stats.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_1.assessment: Zubat's Taunt/U-turn supports Speed Boost Carvanha; Alolan Rattata brings berry-backed Super Fang and Wailmer special spread pressure. Correct faction continuity and four real roles justify preservation. Rock threatens Zubat but is neutral on Carvanha.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_1.acceptance: Trace Taunt interruption, Speed Boost after Protect, Gluttony berry threshold and Super Fang into Ghost immunity.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_1.proposed_crack: Electric pressures Zubat and the Water members; Rock specifically threatens Zubat. Fighting punishes Alolan Rattata, while focused attacks and priority can limit fragile Carvanha if its Protect and speed are accounted for.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_2.assessment: Alolan Grimer/Clauncher gives durable item removal and special coverage; Sheer Force Croconaw and Adaptability Corphish supply physical reserves. Two crack claims are wrong: Dark-typed Alolan Grimer is Psychic-immune, and Sheer Force suppresses Life Orb recoil on eligible attacks.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_2.acceptance: Verify Psychic immunity, Ground weakness and all three Croconaw attacks receiving Sheer Force without Life Orb recoil.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MUSEUM_2.proposed_crack: Ground threatens Alolan Grimer, which is immune to Psychic. Grass and Electric pressure the Water members; Croconaw's Sheer Force attacks avoid Life Orb recoil, so plan direct damage or disruption instead of waiting for that recoil.

TRAINER_ARCHIE_SLATEPORT.assessment: Wingull/Lombre delivers rain with Fake Out support immediately; Corphish, Tentacool, Golbat and Carvanha provide setup, speed reduction and disruption. Archie already has six expert-prepared thematic Pokémon. Preserve exact offsets and all six loadouts.
TRAINER_ARCHIE_SLATEPORT.acceptance: Test rain turn timing, Lombre Fake Out selection, Wingull Roost typing and Carvanha entry when preserving rain is more valuable than immediate damage.

TRAINER_GRETA_SLATEPORT.assessment: Scarf Heracross and Umbreon form a credible damage/sustain lead, with Shedinja introducing immunity precision and last-slot Gastly the actual locked ace. Shedinja is an intentional matchup puzzle and Sash gives conditional insurance. No roster expansion is justified.
TRAINER_GRETA_SLATEPORT.acceptance: Test Wonder Guard with super-effective damage, indirect damage and Mold Breaker; verify Wish healing after replacement and Gastly ace ordering.

TRAINER_ISABEL_1.assessment: This three-member half belongs to a combined multi encounter with Kaleb; do not inflate it to four. Normalize Delcatty, Competitive Wigglytuff and Follow Me Clefable provide offensive support and redirection across the combined board. Speed claims should include Kaleb's fast Boltund.
TRAINER_ISABEL_1.acceptance: Run the combined battle; test Normalize Thunder Wave against Ground/Ghost/Electric and Clefable redirection while Kaleb's attacker occupies the partner slot.

TRAINER_KALEB.assessment: Audino/Granbull/Boltund is the other half of the six-Pokémon multi battle. Regenerator healing support, Intimidate and fast Strong Jaw pressure complement Isabel's control. Preserve independent party ownership and do not presume the second listed Pokémon leads alongside Audino.
TRAINER_KALEB.acceptance: Trace live multi lead selection, Heal Pulse across trainer ownership, Intimidate responses and replacement from Kaleb's own reserves.

TRAINER_SALLY.assessment: Floragato's pivot offense, Kirlia setup and reserve Lopunny/Whimsicott provide varied tactical options. Configured Gen9 Protean activates once per entry, so the plan's every-move type change is stale prose. Preserve moves and use U-turn to reset the ability naturally.
TRAINER_SALLY.acceptance: Test two different attacks in one stay and then a U-turn/re-entry; verify exactly one Protean activation per entry and correct Encore immunity.

TRAINER_EDDIE.assessment: Dugtrio's Earthquake is deliberately paired with Levitate Misdreavus and protected by airborne reserves. Carnivine redirection and Gligar's Flying Gem Acrobatics give different routes. Flying/Levitate avoids Ground attacks, not Dugtrio's Rock Slide or Sucker Punch.
TRAINER_EDDIE.acceptance: Test every legal reserve beside Earthquake, Arena Trap escape rules and Flying Gem consumption raising Acrobatics power in the configured engine.
TRAINER_EDDIE.proposed_crack: Flying and Levitate avoid Earthquake and Arena Trap, but Dugtrio retains Rock Slide and Sucker Punch. Ghost/Dark pressure Misdreavus, Fire/Flying pressure Carnivine, and ability suppression or grounding can change partner safety.

TRAINER_ROBIN.assessment: Indeedee/Meowstic is a complete Psychic Terrain redirection offense. Eevee's Quick Attack is conditional while opposing targets are grounded under terrain; Chimecho provides airborne support without receiving grounded terrain benefits. These reserves are useful, but priority AI must respect the current field.
TRAINER_ROBIN.acceptance: Test Expanding Force spread/boost, grounded versus airborne targets for Quick Attack, Follow Me against spread moves and Chimecho terrain status.

TRAINER_TIMMY.assessment: Stunky/Heliolisk pairs priority denial with fast special pivot offense; Herdier and Ditto add Intimidate and copying. Dry Skin supplies meaningful Water immunity and Fire vulnerability. Stunky's uninvested Flamethrower is targeted coverage rather than its main damage route.
TRAINER_TIMMY.acceptance: Trace Sucker Punch against status, Dry Skin weather/damage changes and Ditto copying after a pivot rather than into a useless target.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_MUDKIP.assessment: Swellow/Manectric preserves the rival's orb-plus-redirection core. Breloom adds Poison Heal sleep, Nuzleaf supplies Fake Out/Sucker Punch and Grovyle immediate Grass offense. The Grass overlap is real but not a demonstrated flaw; preserve this branch's authored identity.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_MUDKIP.acceptance: Verify Mudkip dispatch, Nuzleaf Fake Out enabling Breloom, and Lightning Rod protection with Swellow active.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_TORCHIC.assessment: Marshtomp adds Ground immunity and Sitrus bulk; Eviolite Lombre supplies Fake Out/Icy Wind alongside Breloom. Those reserves change speed and defensive options substantially despite the shared Swellow/Manectric lead.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_TORCHIC.acceptance: Trace Torchic-player dispatch, Lombre speed drops and Marshtomp selection against Electric versus Grass threats.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_TREECKO.assessment: Numel supplies slow special spread pressure and Yawn while Combusken gains speed through Protect. The shared orb lead and Breloom support remain intact. Fire overlap is acceptable because the two reserves perform different jobs.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_110_TREECKO.acceptance: Verify Treecko-player dispatch, Yawn selection versus Spore plans and Combusken Speed Boost after Protect.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_MUDKIP.assessment: May's five-member Grovyle variant exactly mirrors Brendan, including Nuzleaf utility and Poison Heal Breloom. Preserve counterpart parity and independently test dispatch instead of inventing a gender-specific difficulty difference.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_MUDKIP.acceptance: Run May's Mudkip-player route; verify Pickpocket after Sitrus use and correct reserve availability.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_TORCHIC.assessment: May's Marshtomp branch keeps the bulky Lombre support variant. It offers genuine slower-board responses without changing the dangerous protected Swellow opening.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_TORCHIC.acceptance: Run May's Torchic-player route; trace Icy Wind order, Fake Out timing and Marshtomp's Grass weakness.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_TREECKO.assessment: May's Combusken branch retains the Numel special attacker rather than an arbitrary extra physical sweeper. Yawn, Spore, Snarl and Speed Boost give the AI several valid lines from a fixed composition.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_110_TREECKO.acceptance: Run May's Treecko-player route; compare Numel and Breloom replacement under powder immunity and speed pressure.

TRAINER_EDWIN_1.assessment: Lunatone/Solrock/Meowstic is one three-member multi-party half, paired with Joseph's Electric attackers. Levitate and screens complement the combined board, while Icy Wind and burn act on different threats. Preserve ownership and live lead selection.
TRAINER_EDWIN_1.acceptance: Trace combined Lunatone/Toxtricity opening, cross-party speed support and Meowstic's screen choice by incoming damage.

TRAINER_JOSEPH.assessment: Toxtricity/Luxray/Magneton complements Edwin's Psychic half through sound offense, Intimidate and Balloon coverage. Analytic Magneton can benefit from moving late or opponent switches; its Speed investment is not inherently contradictory.
TRAINER_JOSEPH.acceptance: Test Overdrive/Throat Spray, Luxray Intimidate and Balloon/Analytic behavior in the six-opponent multi encounter.

TRAINER_ALYSSA.assessment: Gligar/Fletchinder/Cyclizar contributes physical speed and pivoting to Edward's Psychic half. Shed Tail can only pass to Alyssa's eligible reserves; Gale Wings depends on full HP, which recoil removes. Preserve all three exact loadouts.
TRAINER_ALYSSA.acceptance: Trace multi-side Shed Tail recipients, Sitrus/Regenerator HP and Gale Wings before/after Life Orb or recoil damage.

TRAINER_EDWARD.assessment: Hypno/Xatu/Chimecho supplies paralysis, Magic Bounce and partner healing to Alyssa's attackers. Hypnosis and Thunder Wave are alternate tools and should not be stacked onto one already-statused target. Force Setup must remain board-aware.
TRAINER_EDWARD.acceptance: Test paralysis-versus-sleep choice, bounced Taunt and Heal Pulse across the multi battle's party ownership.

TRAINER_JACLYN.assessment: Shadow Tag Wobbuffet enables Simple Swoobat, with Encore Kadabra and bulky Musharna in reserve. Simple doubles Calm Mind's stat changes, not the number of actions. Preserve the strong combination and clarify its arithmetic.
TRAINER_JACLYN.acceptance: Verify one Calm Mind produces +2 SpA/+2 SpD, Stored Power scales correctly, and trapped Ghost/pivot escape rules.

TRAINER_ANTHONY.assessment: Doduo/Zebstrika applies mixed coverage and pivot pressure, followed by Belly Drum Linoone or special Magneton. Linoone's Sitrus immediately changes the HP consequence of Drum; that is the only clear explanatory defect.
TRAINER_ANTHONY.acceptance: Trace Linoone HP and Sitrus after Drum, Sap Sipper against Grass and Balloon replacement selection.
TRAINER_ANTHONY.proposed_crack: Ground threatens Zebstrika, while Rock/Electric pressure Doduo. Disrupt Belly Drum before resolution or prepare a calculated Extreme Speed answer; Sitrus normally heals Linoone immediately rather than leaving it at half HP for a full turn.

TRAINER_ABIGAIL_1.assessment: Scolipede and Ponyta pressure with physical attacks, while Raboot pivots and Toxtricity supplies special sound damage. Speed Boost raises Speed, not bulk; the plan must not imply two boosts improve survivability. Preserve the roster and qualify the prose.
TRAINER_ABIGAIL_1.acceptance: Test Speed Boost's actual stat effect, Libero once per entry and Toxtricity entry against physical mitigation.
TRAINER_ABIGAIL_1.proposed_crack: Rock pressure threatens much of the opening, and Psychic/Flying threaten Scolipede. Speed Boost improves turn order without increasing bulk; account for Focus Sash and Protect when concentrating damage.

TRAINER_BENJAMIN_1.assessment: Persian Fake Out/Icy Wind enables Kilowattrel's Tailwind and Wind Power charge. Trumbeak's multihit attacks and Gligar's Gem Acrobatics maintain physical reserve variety. No strategic simplification is appropriate for this casual trainer.
TRAINER_BENJAMIN_1.acceptance: Test Tailwind triggering Wind Power, charged Thunderbolt consumption and Icy Wind utility despite physical Persian investment.

TRAINER_JASMINE.assessment: Thwackey/Quaxwell combines terrain priority and Moxie, while Quilava and Liquid Voice Brionne provide special spread finishers. Grassy Terrain benefits grounded opponents too. Quaxwell is pure Water here, so Flying is not its weakness.
TRAINER_JASMINE.acceptance: Verify Grassy Glide priority and Liquid Voice/Throat Spray interaction; test terrain replacement against the lead.
TRAINER_JASMINE.proposed_crack: Flying pressures Thwackey; Grass and Electric threaten pure-Water Quaxwell and Brionne. Water/Rock pressure Quilava, while removing terrain takes away Grassy Glide priority and also ends its shared grounded healing.

TRAINER_JACOB.assessment: Ferroseed/Druddigon punishes contact, Lycanroc supplies immediate priority and Cyclizar can preserve a partner's action window. Shed Tail is useful only with an eligible benched recipient and sufficient HP; the slow lead still has real damage and denial.
TRAINER_JACOB.acceptance: Test multi-contact Helmet/Barbs damage, Rough Skin contact, and Shed Tail with eligible versus exhausted reserves.

TRAINER_WALLY_MAUVILLE.assessment: Swablu Tailwind supports iconic Kirlia, with Roselia sleep and Sturdy/Balloon Magneton behind. Wally's recognizable partner already has a central offensive role. The crack's Poison claim ignores Kirlia's Psychic STAB; preserve team and correct matchup language.
TRAINER_WALLY_MAUVILLE.acceptance: Trace Kirlia setup under Tailwind, Roselia powder immunity and Balloon popping without incorrectly consuming Sturdy.
TRAINER_WALLY_MAUVILLE.proposed_crack: Steel resists Kirlia's STAB, while Poison threatens its Fairy typing but risks Psychic retaliation. Fire/Ground pressure Magneton once appropriate immunity is removed; Rock/Ice threaten Swablu and disruption can limit Tailwind or setup.

TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_1.assessment: Slow Oranguru can Instruct Band Hitmonlee after its attack; Lickitung and Trumbeak provide additional eligible attack partners. Preserve this deliberate timing. Instruct must not repeat a crash or an attack into an immunity merely to obey the plan.
TRAINER_ANNA_AND_MEG_1.acceptance: Test Instruct after successful High Jump Kick, after a failed/crashed move and with a protected target; verify no suicidal repeat.

TRAINER_ISAAC_1.assessment: Munchlax/Togepi has real redirection-backed Curse; Abra, Dratini and Staryu broaden offense before Mega Kangaskhan. This is a strong example of babies participating in expert teams. Preserve the exact six and ensure post-Brawly Mega access is aligned.
TRAINER_ISAAC_1.acceptance: Trace Follow Me/Wish-free support, Curse and Dragon Dance windows, then legal Mega Kangaskhan generation and Parental Bond behavior.

TRAINER_MARIA_1.assessment: Froslass/Salandit combines Destiny Bond and setup with fast offensive reserves. Lycanroc's priority and Raboot's pivot prevent a pure special strategy. Corrosion does not make Poison damage hit Steel; Salandit has no Toxic here, so its ability is incidental rather than a fabricated poison engine.
TRAINER_MARIA_1.acceptance: Test Destiny Bond timing and repeat restriction, Salandit attacking Steel with Fire rather than Poison and Libero re-entry reset.

TRAINER_DEREK.assessment: All three Wormadam forms plus Mothim are an intentional collector identity with different investments. Sandy form is physical, Trash uses defense and special damage, Plant/Mothim use Quiver Dance. Overcoat protects three members from powder; Ground is neutral on Bug/Steel Trash.
TRAINER_DEREK.acceptance: Test each form's typing and Overcoat, Iron Defense survival and Mothim Tinted Lens into resistance.
TRAINER_DEREK.proposed_crack: Fire is especially dangerous to Plant and Trash forms; Water threatens Sandy, and Flying pressures Plant/Mothim. Ground is neutral on Bug/Steel Trash. Taunt limits setup, while Overcoat invalidates powder-based disruption against the Wormadam forms.

TRAINER_LYDIA_1.assessment: Froakie/Smoochum offers Fake Out and Protean offense, with physical Magby, Friend Guard Happiny, Gible and Band Larvesta as meaningful reserves. First-stage status does not make these automatically weak; preserve the carefully varied nursery composition.
TRAINER_LYDIA_1.acceptance: Test Friend Guard's partner reduction, Protean once per entry and Larvesta U-turn selecting a useful receiver.

TRAINER_AISHA.assessment: Hariyama/Gurdurr creates bulky Fake Out plus Iron Fist pressure; Farfetch'd and Hitmontop add critical hits, screen removal, Intimidate and Feint. This independent four-mon branch already has substantial tactical depth. Replace shared prose denying a second gear.
TRAINER_AISHA.acceptance: Test Feint enabling the ally attack, Intimidate against punish abilities and screen-breaking selection.
TRAINER_AISHA.proposed_crack: Flying and Psychic pressure the Fighting roster, but Fake Out, priority, Intimidate, critical hits and Feint produce several credible responses. Match the active pair and avoid assuming the team has only one line.

TRAINER_BRANDI.assessment: Bronzor/Kirlia establishes Room behind Levitate bulk; Musharna offers sustain while Wobbuffet traps and counters. These are four independent Pokémon, not a three-trainer combined party. The inherited plan omits the actual Room lead and should be rewritten.
TRAINER_BRANDI.acceptance: Test Trick Room when already active, Reflect choice, Calm Mind under threat and Shadow Tag replacements.
TRAINER_BRANDI.proposed_crack: Ghost and Dark pressure the Psychic core, with Kirlia's Fairy coverage changing Dark matchups. Taunt or direct pressure can limit Room and setup; Ghosts and valid pivot tools can escape Wobbuffet's trapping.

TRAINER_MELINA.assessment: Yanma/Trumbeak combines special Speed Boost and physical multihit offense; Persian adds Fake Out/Icy Wind and Gligar an immunity pivot. This is a complete expert four-mon branch despite inherited prose calling it gearless.
TRAINER_MELINA.acceptance: Test Speed Boost after Protect, multihit against Sash and Persian replacement when speed control changes the outcome.
TRAINER_MELINA.proposed_crack: Rock pressures the aerial core, while Ice is especially dangerous to Gligar. Fake Out, Icy Wind, multihit attacks and pivots give this team alternate lines; Electric is ineffective against Gligar's Ground typing.

TRAINER_VICTOR.assessment: Staravia Tailwind/Intimidate supports Huge Power Diggersby. Galarian Linoone uses Flame Orb Quick Feet, while final Miltank sustains through Curse and Milk Drink. Burn still affects non-Facade physical attacks without Guts; preserve the intended Facade focus.
TRAINER_VICTOR.acceptance: Trace Quick Feet versus burn damage modifiers, Tailwind timing and last-slot Miltank ace release.

TRAINER_VICTORIA.assessment: Own Tempo Lilligant and Prankster Whimsicott support special setup, with Blissey screens/paralysis and Roserade as final ace. Poison types do not inherently ignore Leech Seed; Grass types do. The roster itself needs no replacement.
TRAINER_VICTORIA.acceptance: Test Own Tempo during Petal Dance, Leech Seed against Grass/Poison and Blissey screen selection.
TRAINER_VICTORIA.proposed_crack: Fire/Flying pressure the Grass core and Fighting pressures Blissey. Grass types are immune to Leech Seed; Poison typing alone is not. Taunt and targeted damage can constrain support while Roserade's coverage remains relevant.

TRAINER_VIVI.assessment: Contrary Fomantis and Unaware Quagsire lead with boost-control asymmetry; Virizion brings premium physical setup and Vibrava is the actual final ace. Keep Virizion's early presence. Coba/Rindo berries create survival thresholds requiring calculation, not generic rarity correction.
TRAINER_VIVI.acceptance: Trace Contrary Leaf Storm, Unaware versus enemy boosts, resistance berry consumption and final Vibrava mixed coverage.

TRAINER_VICKY.assessment: Togetic protects Machamp setup or accurate attacks, with Band Pawmot and Sturdy Sawk finishing. Choice-locked Double Shock requires switching after Electric typing is lost; the AI must understand that conditional reserve line. Fast opponents do not literally gain two actions from speed alone.
TRAINER_VICKY.acceptance: Test Follow Me with spread attacks, No Guard against evasion and Pawmot forced switch after Double Shock.
TRAINER_VICKY.proposed_crack: Spread attacks bypass Follow Me, and suitable Flying/Psychic/Fairy coverage pressures the Fighting members. Own Tempo prevents confusion. Faster opponents act earlier but gain no automatic extra action; account for support, Sturdy and Pawmot's Choice lock.

TRAINER_HAYDEN.assessment: Growlithe/Houndoom links Intimidate, sun-boosted recovery and Heat Wave, while Litleo and Quick Feet Linoone diversify damage. Houndoom's Heat Wave remains useful after Growlithe falls; the crack's dependency is false.
TRAINER_HAYDEN.acceptance: Test Morning Sun under sun and other weather, Flash Fire immunity and Linoone burn/Facade interaction.
TRAINER_HAYDEN.proposed_crack: Water, Rock and Ground threaten the Fire members, with sunlight weakening Water attacks. Remove or replace sun to reduce recovery and Fire pressure; Houndoom remains an offensive threat after Growlithe falls.

TRAINER_BIANCA.assessment: Band Rock Head Sudowoodo benefits from Pumpkaboo's burns and contact punishment; Sap Sipper Skiddo and Own Tempo Lilligant are distinct setup reserves. This unusual picnic has a coherent mixed plan, with obvious weaknesses remaining legitimate.
TRAINER_BIANCA.acceptance: Test burn support of Sudowoodo, Sap Sipper against Grass, and recoil-free Head Smash/Wood Hammer.

TRAINER_TYRON.assessment: Scyther/Kabuto has immediate physical pressure and optional setup, then Mega Beedrill or Speed Boost Scolipede. The Mega is an authored powerful discovery for an ordinary trainer. Preserve it; ensure setup is not chosen into unavoidable knockouts.
TRAINER_TYRON.acceptance: Test Weak Armor activation/order, Mega Beedrill's actual ability and Swords Dance versus immediate attacking lines.

TRAINER_CELINA.assessment: Gloom/Tsareena combines sleep and priority denial, with Triage Comfey and Roselia offering healing offense or more sleep. Tsareena is Jolly with full Speed investment; the crack's automatic double-hit premise is unjustified. Fire/Flying are not universal weaknesses across Comfey.
TRAINER_CELINA.acceptance: Test Queenly Majesty against targeted priority, Triage under opposing priority denial and powder immunities.
TRAINER_CELINA.proposed_crack: Fire/Flying pressure the Grass members, while Steel and Poison pressure Comfey. Queenly Majesty blocks relevant opposing priority, so remove or suppress Tsareena before relying on it; calculate Speed instead of assuming two hits before it acts.

TRAINER_ROSE_1.assessment: Configured Intimidate Vespiquen protects Roserade's sleep/Leaf Storm lead; Floette and Pumpkaboo sustain a defensive alternate board. Flower Veil protects Grass allies from applicable status/stat drops, not all partners universally. Preserve this deliberate ability ecology.
TRAINER_ROSE_1.acceptance: Verify Intimidate Vespiquen is configured, Flower Veil on Grass versus non-Grass allies and Wish replacement healing.

TRAINER_DALTON_1.assessment: Noibat's Tailwind/Super Fang supports Loudred's special spread offense; Stantler adds Intimidate and Yanma autonomous speed. The normal/sound theme remains visible while reserves provide genuinely different utilities.
TRAINER_DALTON_1.acceptance: Test Soundproof interaction, Super Fang into Ghost and Wind timing; verify Stantler Clear Amulet blocks applicable drops.

TRAINER_DEANDRE.assessment: Krokorok/Simisear opens with Intimidate and mixed Fire/Fighting coverage. Vullaby supplies Taunt/Snarl sustain and Quilava immediate special Fire damage. Preserve the actual lead instead of treating plan order as party order.
TRAINER_DEANDRE.acceptance: Test Simisear burn versus damage, Vullaby switch into powder and Krokorok Intimidate into punish abilities.

TRAINER_KIRK.assessment: Pincurchin/Dedenne establishes terrain with berry sustain; Togedemaru, Emolga, Morpeko and Scarf Boltund create varied speed/ability routes. Terrain protects only grounded Pokémon from sleep and only grounded attackers receive its Electric boost; the floating reserves are exceptions.
TRAINER_KIRK.acceptance: Test sleep on grounded Dedenne versus airborne Emolga/Balloon Togedemaru and Morpeko Aura Wheel typing each turn.

TRAINER_VIVIAN.assessment: Plusle/Minun has real paired offense and screens; Klink, Raichu, Electabuzz and Specs Zebstrika are varied reserves. Discharge from Zebstrika is safe beside Lightning Rod Raichu but not automatically safe beside other Electric allies, which merely resist it.
TRAINER_VIVIAN.acceptance: Test Plus/Minus loss after replacement, Lightning Rod partner targeting and Discharge friendly damage with each eligible reserve.

TRAINER_BEN.assessment: Battery Charjabug plus Volt Absorb Lanturn intentionally turns Discharge into support and spread pressure. Stunfisk, Jolteon, Heliolisk and Vikavolt require partner-specific discharge choices; Levitate does not grant Electric immunity. Preserve the combo and gate unsafe actions.
TRAINER_BEN.acceptance: Test Battery boost and Volt Absorb healing, then prohibit damaging a vulnerable reserve when a better non-spread action exists.

TRAINER_ANGELO.assessment: Joltik/Wattrel supplies accurate Thunder and Tailwind; Rotom, Kilowattrel, Toxtricity and Luxray vary immunity, damage category and switching. Throat Spray raises SpA rather than Speed or bulk, so prose should not attribute those qualities to its presence.
TRAINER_ANGELO.acceptance: Trace Compound Eyes accuracy, Wind Power after Tailwind and Throat Spray's exact stat increase.

TRAINER_SHAWN.assessment: Bellibolt/Alolan Raichu uses manual terrain to accelerate special setup; Rotom-Wash, Pawmot and Eelektross support Mega Ampharos as final ace. The crack misstates grounding and typing: several members are grounded, Mega Ampharos is 2x Ice-weak, and Fighting is not a blanket answer.
TRAINER_SHAWN.acceptance: Test terrain activation changing Raichu order, Electromorphosis charge and Mega Ampharos typing, plus Choice-locked Double Shock switching.
TRAINER_SHAWN.proposed_crack: Ground pressures grounded Bellibolt, Alolan Raichu, Pawmot and Ampharos while Levitate protects Rotom-Wash/Eelektross unless bypassed. Mega Ampharos is weak to Ice, Dragon, Fairy and Ground; it is not fourfold Ice-weak. Use target-specific coverage and disrupt terrain where useful.

TRAINER_WATTSON_1.assessment: Electrode/Electivire is a clean Discharge/Motor Drive engine with partner-safe Ground coverage. Magnezone, Thundurus and Galvantula cover different responses; iconic Mega Manectric remains a meaningful final ace. Preserve all six and their optimized preparations.
TRAINER_WATTSON_1.acceptance: Trace same-turn Motor Drive speed, Discharge with every reserve partner, Mega Manectric's change from Lightning Rod to Intimidate and terrain duration after pivots.

TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_1.assessment: Loudred/Chatot preserves the interview's sound identity while using Scrappy and Tailwind; Toucannon multihit/Beak Blast and Band Dodrio retain physical reserve threats. The catalog already upgrades the old two-mon concept coherently.
TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_1.acceptance: Test Scrappy Hyper Voice into Ghost, Beak Blast contact burn timing and reserve selection against Wide Guard.

TRAINER_WILTON_1.assessment: Cofagrigus/Claydol supports slow Golett and Mega Steelix with Room and burn. Mental Herb makes a single Taunt insufficient, contrary to the crack. Preserve the archaic/ruins identity and exact ace ordering.
TRAINER_WILTON_1.acceptance: Test first Taunt consumption, repeated disruption, Mummy contact transfer and Mega Steelix replacing Sturdy.
TRAINER_WILTON_1.proposed_crack: Cofagrigus's Mental Herb absorbs the first applicable disruption, so repeated denial, direct removal or managing Room turns are distinct answers. Use target-specific Ghost/Dark/Water coverage; Grass is neutral on Ground/Steel Steelix.

TRAINER_BROOKE_1.assessment: Raikou/Infernape is direct offense plus Fake Out, with Harvest Exeggutor sleep and Mega Blastoise pulses in reserve. The exotic early Raikou does not invalidate this coherent Ace team. Blastoise's role depends on its actual Mega Launcher move multipliers.
TRAINER_BROOKE_1.acceptance: Test Fake Out supporting Raikou, Harvest under normal versus sunny weather and each Mega Launcher pulse including Aura Sphere.

TRAINER_CELIA.assessment: Parasect/Jumpluff pairs sleep with Gem Acrobatics and Encore; Pumpkaboo and configured Flare Boost Gourgeist offer physical mitigation and special offense. Preserve their distinct roles, including Dry Skin's heightened Fire risk.
TRAINER_CELIA.acceptance: Test powder immunity, Gem consumption/Acrobatics power and Flare Boost after Flame Orb activation.

TRAINER_BRYAN.assessment: Scarf Tyrantrum pressures while Carracosta can Smash behind Sturdy; Serperior and Aurorus add Contrary and Refrigerate special routes. White Herb repairs defense drops, so automatic post-Smash fragility is false. Preserve the powerful fossil-themed quartet.
TRAINER_BRYAN.acceptance: Trace Sturdy plus White Herb, recoil-free Head Smash, Contrary Leaf Storm and Refrigerate/Throat Spray damage.
TRAINER_BRYAN.proposed_crack: Grass threatens Carracosta, while suitable Fighting/Steel coverage pressures the fossils and Fire/Ice pressures Serperior. Carracosta's White Herb restores Shell Smash defense drops; use calculated damage and account for Sturdy rather than assuming a free knockout.

TRAINER_BRANDEN.assessment: Perrserker Fake Out and Steely Spirit augment Steelworker Dhelmise's Anchor Shot, with Sirfetch'd coverage and Storm Drain Cradily in reserve. This is a particularly cohesive ability-stacking team worth preserving in full.
TRAINER_BRANDEN.acceptance: Measure stacked Steelworker/Steely Spirit Anchor Shot, trapping exceptions and Storm Drain when Cradily replaces an ally.

TRAINER_TED.assessment: Scarf Gardevoir can attack or cripple a passive target with Trick while Alolan Persian supplies Fake Out/Taunt. Copperajah and Heatproof Bronzong offer bulky physical reserves. The difference between Heatproof and Levitate must remain visible to prediction.
TRAINER_TED.acceptance: Test Trick against nonexchangeable items, Fur Coat damage and Heatproof Bronzong receiving Ground attacks normally.

TRAINER_PAUL.assessment: Corrosion Salazzle and Amoonguss create an immediate status/redirection puzzle, with Specs Skrelp and Roserade adding damage. Toxic and sleep compete for status slots, so the AI must choose a coherent partner plan. Corrosion affects status poisoning, not Poison attack immunity.
TRAINER_PAUL.acceptance: Test Toxic into Steel, Sludge Bomb into Steel, Rage Powder against Goggles/Grass and no redundant status allocation by both partners.

TRAINER_GEORGIA.assessment: Butterfree supports Weakness Policy Metang through sleep/redirection; Hattrem and Xatu provide separate Magic Bounce reserves. Fire and Ghost absolutely can trigger Metang's Policy if it survives, so the counterplay text contradicts its central item.
TRAINER_GEORGIA.acceptance: Test Policy activation on surviving Fire/Ghost hits, powder immunity, and Healing Wish only when a useful eligible replacement exists.
TRAINER_GEORGIA.proposed_crack: Disrupt Butterfree's powder plan with immunity, Taunt where Magic Bounce is absent, or direct pressure. Super-effective Fire/Ghost damage triggers Metang's Weakness Policy if it survives; seek a knockout or control its boosted follow-up rather than treating those types as safe chip.

TRAINER_MIKE_2.assessment: Gigalith/Graveler shares sand-safe Rock identity with different Body Press/setup lines. Primeape punishes Intimidate and Donphan brings removal plus Ice Spinner. Preserve the physical specialization and distinct reserve tools.
TRAINER_MIKE_2.acceptance: Test Rock Polish changing actual order, sand's Rock special-defense benefit and Rapid Spin versus attacking when no hazards exist.

TRAINER_TRAVIS.assessment: Archeops/Gogoat combines Gem burst and recovery, with Crustle/Scyther setup reserves. Defeatist halves offensive stats rather than disabling attacks; White Herb also protects Crustle's defenses after Smash. Preserve roster and repair advice.
TRAINER_TRAVIS.acceptance: Test Archeops above/below half HP and Crustle White Herb restoration, plus Sap Sipper switching into Grass.
TRAINER_TRAVIS.proposed_crack: Chip Archeops below half HP to reduce its offensive stats; it can still attack. Fire/Flying threaten Gogoat, while suitable Water/Steel pressure Crustle; account for both Sturdy and White Herb when denying Shell Smash.

TRAINER_BRICE.assessment: Excadrill/Lairon supplies powerful partner-safe physical damage and optional setup. Heatproof Bronzong and Levitate Claydol add screen/support coverage. Casual rank does not justify reducing this complete strategy.
TRAINER_BRICE.acceptance: Test Mold Breaker through Sturdy, Rock Head Head Smash and differing Ground immunity between Bronzong and Claydol.

TRAINER_TRENT_1.assessment: Donphan supports sand-setting Probopass through removal/item control; Camerupt and Rapidash offer slow special versus fast physical Fire pressure. No member has Wide Guard, so the crack mentions a nonexistent defense. Grass is not super-effective on the entire roster.
TRAINER_TRENT_1.acceptance: Test Sand Force move categories, Sand Veil under sand and Rapidash reserve selection into Grass attacks.
TRAINER_TRENT_1.proposed_crack: Water pressures Donphan, Probopass and Camerupt; Ground/Fighting are especially dangerous to Probopass. Grass does not hit every member super effectively. This roster has no Wide Guard, so evaluate actual Protect and coverage choices.

TRAINER_LARRY.assessment: Cacturne/Victreebel uses priority and sleep-backed physical setup, with Sap Sipper Gogoat and Steelworker Dhelmise providing bulk and trapping. Victreebel's Jolly investment is purposeful and prevents treating all targets as automatically faster.
TRAINER_LARRY.acceptance: Test Sleep Powder creating setup opportunity, Sucker Punch into nonattacks and Grass immunity on Gogoat entry.

TRAINER_BRYANT.assessment: Scarf Typhlosion/Magcargo opens with Eruption plus Balloon coverage, backed by physical Heatmor and Hisuian Arcanine. This is its own four-mon encounter; Shayla's sun is not a permanent shared teammate. Preserve but write a branch-specific plan.
TRAINER_BRYANT.acceptance: Measure Eruption before/after chip and Balloon/Weak Armor activation, then choose physical reserves against special walls.

TRAINER_SHAYLA.assessment: Sunflora/Bellossom has real manual sun, Weather Ball and Chlorophyll setup, with Florges and Tsareena supporting status/stat and priority denial. These are four independently owned Pokémon; Bryant's Typhlosion is not present in this branch.
TRAINER_SHAYLA.acceptance: Test Solar Beam under replaced sun, Flower Veil on Grass allies and Queenly Majesty during a protected setup turn.

TRAINER_LAWRENCE.assessment: Hippowdon/Sandslash runs direct sand speed, while Cradily counters single-target Water and Torterra Wide Guards. All four are sand-safe. Keep this well-supported habitat team rather than interpreting a shared plan as combined trainers.
TRAINER_LAWRENCE.acceptance: Test Storm Drain versus spread Water, Wide Guard versus single-target attacks and Sand Rush after weather replacement.

TRAINER_LUNG.assessment: Weezing/Ninjask creates burn-backed physical setup, with Safety Goggles Shedinja and Dancer Oricorio as unusual reserves. Goggles specifically protects Shedinja from sand, contrary to shared crack prose; Oricorio can copy Ninjask's Swords Dance if active, though special offense benefits little.
TRAINER_LUNG.acceptance: Test Goggles weather/powder immunity, Wonder Guard indirect damage and Dancer timing with Ninjask's Swords Dance.
TRAINER_LUNG.proposed_crack: Fire, Ghost, Dark, Flying or Rock coverage can threaten Shedinja through Wonder Guard, and burn remains dangerous. Its Safety Goggles prevents sand and powder effects. Rock pressure is useful against the aerial bugs, while Weezing's Levitate changes Ground targeting.

TRAINER_WYATT.assessment: Gabite/Pupitar offers physical pressure and hazards; Shelgon Dragon Dance and White Herb Turtonator add distinct setup routes. Pupitar is Rock/Ground rather than Dragon, so Fairy does not universally answer this collector's roster.
TRAINER_WYATT.acceptance: Test Overcoat powder immunity, Shed Skin status recovery and Turtonator White Herb after Shell Smash.
TRAINER_WYATT.proposed_crack: Ice strongly threatens Gabite and pressures Shelgon, while Fairy pressures the Dragon members. Pupitar is Rock/Ground and is especially vulnerable to Water/Grass; Turtonator's Fire/Dragon typing makes Ice neutral, so choose coverage by the active pair.

TRAINER_JAYLEN.assessment: Cryogonal's actual move is Snowscape, not the Haze promised by its plan. Snow supports the Ice members' physical defense; Magnezone provides coverage and the reserves combine Scarf Gorilla Tactics with priority Mamoswine. Preserve the loadouts and fix the description.
TRAINER_JAYLEN.acceptance: Test snow's physical-defense modifier and freeze-free weather, Analytic timing, and Darmanitan's combined ability/item lock.

TRAINER_MADELINE_1.assessment: Castform rain enables Forecast Weather Ball, Thunder and Hurricane accuracy; Vanillish adds Freeze-Dry and the physical reserves Sawsbuck/Toucannon cover alternate defenses. This is a complete themed quartet despite modest species.
TRAINER_MADELINE_1.acceptance: Test Forecast typing immediately after weather change, Freeze-Dry against Water and Weak Armor speed after a physical hit.

TRAINER_TORI_AND_TIA.assessment: Ribombee/Oricorio-Pom-Pom has genuine Quiver Dance copying, with Sensu as an alternate active Dancer and Goggles Shedinja as a distinct endgame puzzle. Only active Dancers copy, not reserves. Sweet Veil protects against sleep while Ribombee remains.
TRAINER_TORI_AND_TIA.acceptance: Test one dance copied only by active Oricorio, Revelation Dance typing and Sweet Veil blocking sleep on the partner.

TRAINER_LAO_1.assessment: Zoroark's last eligible party disguise is Pangoro, not the already-active Greninja named in prose. Gen9 Protean also acts once per entry. Thievul's Stakeout/Parting Shot and Policy Pangoro remain useful reserves. Preserve order and explain actual deception.
TRAINER_LAO_1.acceptance: Verify initial Illusion species in doubles, disguise break, once-per-entry Protean and Stakeout after an opponent switches.

TRAINER_DILLON.assessment: Mamoswine/Garganacl combines immediate offense with Salt Cure sustain; Torterra adds Wide Guard and Scarf Darmanitan finishing speed. Purifying Salt's status immunity makes usual burn/toxic lines invalid. Bulk investments deliberately divide special and physical resilience.
TRAINER_DILLON.acceptance: Test Salt Cure on Water/Steel versus other types, Purifying Salt status immunity and Torterra Yache/Wide Guard interactions.

TRAINER_COBY.assessment: Corvisquire sets Tailwind beside Toucannon, with high-critical Honchkrow and special Oricorio in reserve. The plan's adjacent Sophie team is not part of this four-member battle. Dancer is incidental without a teammate dance but can react to an opponent.
TRAINER_COBY.acceptance: Test Tailwind, Beak Blast contact timing and Super Luck/Scope Lens critical stages, including stage-bypass damage.

TRAINER_SOPHIE.assessment: Forretress hazards/Red Card supports Delphox's special offense, with Sawsbuck Helping Hand and Parasect sleep in reserve. A forced switch into Spikes is a real interaction; hazards must still compete with immediate board impact.
TRAINER_SOPHIE.acceptance: Test Red Card eligibility after Sturdy survival, hazards on forced entry and Helping Hand when Delphox is active.

TRAINER_NOLAN.assessment: Commander Dondozo/Tatsugiri is a sophisticated opening; Unaware and defensive investment make the boosted fish resilient. Palafin and Regenerator Slowbro supply a second board after Commander ends. Palafin needs a legal switch to become Hero; Commander leaves only one attacking battler while active.
TRAINER_NOLAN.acceptance: Trace Commander boosts and hidden partner behavior, Order Up form-specific boost, Palafin Flip Turn with available reserves and Slowbro regeneration.

TRAINER_CHARLOTTE.assessment: Shadow Tag Gothorita creates Room for Komala's setup and bulky Bouffalant/Armarouge reserves. Fake Tears primarily benefits Armarouge rather than the physical opening partner. Preserve this conditional utility and reject support moves that do not help the current damage route.
TRAINER_CHARLOTTE.acceptance: Test Fake Tears with physical versus special partners, Comatose status interactions and Room under a slower opposing board.

TRAINER_KAI.assessment: Grapploct/Sealeo uses trapping, recovery damage and speed reduction, with Greninja/Chesnaught providing fast offense or physical protection. Unlike Charlotte's separate branch it has no Trick Room setter; shared prose should not imply one.
TRAINER_KAI.acceptance: Test Octolock escape rules, Brine below half HP, Bulletproof move exclusions and Greninja Protean re-entry.

TRAINER_CLAUDE.assessment: Huntail/Gorebyss pairs physical priority with manual-rain special pressure; Focus Energy Sniper Seadra and Rotom-Wash are distinct reserves. Scope Lens makes Focus Energy a real critical plan, but it must be chosen only with a viable window.
TRAINER_CLAUDE.acceptance: Test guaranteed-crit threshold after Focus Energy, Sniper multiplier and rain replacement; verify Rotom-Wash resists rather than fears Electric.

TRAINER_TYRA_AND_IVY.assessment: Throh Coaching/Wide Guard supports Weakness Policy Pangoro, then Iron Fist Hitmonchan or Scrappy Sirfetch'd. This is a coherent support/offense composition. Pangoro is Psychic-immune, and Wide Guard blocks special spread moves too, contradicting the crack.
TRAINER_TYRA_AND_IVY.acceptance: Test Coaching, Wide Guard against physical and special spread attacks and Psychic into Pangoro.
TRAINER_TYRA_AND_IVY.proposed_crack: Flying/Fairy pressure these fighters, especially fourfold-Fairy-weak Pangoro, which is immune to Psychic. Single-target moves bypass Wide Guard regardless of damage category; avoid feeding a surviving Pangoro a free Weakness Policy boost.

TRAINER_SHANE.assessment: Centiskorch Fire Lash can aid physical reserves while Mismagius threatens Nasty Plot and broad special coverage. Dhelmise traps and Band Ceruledge offers healing priority offense. Preserve unusual composition; no forced shared-speed strategy is required.
TRAINER_SHANE.acceptance: Test Fire Lash lowering defense for the partner, Flash Fire immunity and Weak Armor Ceruledge after contact.

TRAINER_STEVE_1.assessment: Turtonator/Alolan Graveler combines special setup and Galvanize physical pressure; Fraxure and Tyrantrum offer setup versus Scarf reserves. Ground is 4x on Rock/Electric Graveler but only 2x on Fire/Dragon Turtonator.
TRAINER_STEVE_1.acceptance: Test Galvanize Double-Edge typing/recoil, White Herb restoration and Mold Breaker Ground coverage.
TRAINER_STEVE_1.proposed_crack: Ground is fourfold effective against Alolan Graveler and twofold against Turtonator. Fairy pressures Fraxure and Tyrantrum; Taunt or direct damage can interrupt setup, while Scarf Tyrantrum remains immediately dangerous.

TRAINER_BERNIE_1.assessment: Pyroar/Alolan Marowak splits sound special damage and Thick Club physical pressure, with Reckless Rapidash and Hisuian Typhlosion as reserves. Lightning Rod protects Electric targeting while burn supports Infernal Parade. Keep the coherent type-specialist construction.
TRAINER_BERNIE_1.acceptance: Test Competitive after drops, Thick Club damage, Poltergeist against itemless targets and Infernal Parade on statused opponents.

TRAINER_LENNY.assessment: Specs Scrappy Exploud is correctly led with Telepathy Noibat and can pair with Soundproof Hakamo-o. Drifblim is not safe from Scrappy Boomburst despite Ghost typing, a crucial reserve interaction. Preserve roster but require ally-aware action selection.
TRAINER_LENNY.acceptance: Test Boomburst beside all three possible partners, including damaging Drifblim; choose coverage or switch when that damage is unjustified.

TRAINER_ANGELINA.assessment: Glaceon/Alolan Sandslash uses manual snow and Slush Rush; Avalugg and Forretress offer physical defense and hazards. Icy Rock makes this branch's snow last eight turns, unlike its inherited five-turn crack. Preserve its distinct manual-weather identity.
TRAINER_ANGELINA.acceptance: Test Icy Rock duration, Slush Rush order and Avalugg Sturdy/Policy at full versus chipped HP.
TRAINER_ANGELINA.proposed_crack: Fire strongly threatens Alolan Sandslash and Forretress; special pressure can bypass Avalugg's physical bulk. Glaceon's Icy Rock extends its snow to eight turns, so weather replacement may be more efficient than waiting it out.

TRAINER_LUCAS_1.assessment: Alolan Ninetales/Beartic establishes Veil and Slush Rush immediately, with a second rusher and Froslass as reserves. Light Clay extends Veil rather than snow. Fighting is neutral on Ice/Fairy Ninetales and ineffective on Froslass, so it is not universal coverage.
TRAINER_LUCAS_1.acceptance: Test separate five-turn snow/eight-turn Veil timers, Froslass Destiny Bond and Fighting immunities.
TRAINER_LUCAS_1.proposed_crack: Replace snow before Veil is set or remove the established screen directly. Fire pressures the Ice roster, but Fighting is neutral on Alolan Ninetales and cannot hit Ghost Froslass; respect Slush Rush while snow persists.

TRAINER_COURTNEY_METEOR_FALLS.assessment: The twelve-opponent two-trainer doubles structure pairs Courtney's Lunatone with the grunt's Solrock. Minior Smash, Mega Aerodactyl and three varied reserves support meteorite identity. White Herb consumption enables Acrobatics, while Shields Down changes stats/status vulnerability. Preserve this authored major encounter.
TRAINER_COURTNEY_METEOR_FALLS.acceptance: Trace live twelve-mon two-trainer party ownership, Minior form/Herb/Acrobatics, legal single Mega across Courtney's party and cross-party Icy Wind support.

TRAINER_GRUNT_METEOR_FALLS.assessment: Solrock burns beside Courtney's special lead; Houndoom/Mightyena sustain offense and disruption, while Magcargo, Crobat and Hippowdon vary late weather and damage. Sand can break allied Sashes and modifies the whole shared board; assess entry globally.
TRAINER_GRUNT_METEOR_FALLS.acceptance: Run all replacement combinations around Hippowdon's sand, ally Sash chip and Intimidate; verify no party truncation in the major two-trainer doubles encounter.

TRAINER_NICOLAS_1.assessment: Helping Hand Alolan Exeggutor supports Hustle Dracozolt's Bolt Beak; Dragonair offers paralysis and Mega Altaria a different boosted finisher. No member has Trick Room despite the crack. Wide Lens mitigates Hustle but does not guarantee hits.
TRAINER_NICOLAS_1.acceptance: Test Bolt Beak action-order doubling, Hustle/Wide Lens accuracy and Mega Altaria Pixilate Double-Edge after Dragon Dance.
TRAINER_NICOLAS_1.proposed_crack: Ice/Fairy pressure the Dragon core, while Steel resists Mega Altaria's Pixilate attack. This team has no Trick Room. Disrupt paralysis or setup and control turn order to limit Bolt Beak's conditional double power.

TRAINER_JOHN_AND_JAY_1.assessment: Volbeat's current set has Tail Glow and Encore but no Baton Pass. Slowbro supports a self-boosting Volbeat; Illumise and Centiskorch add healing/support or physical Fire pressure. Preserve the actual functional quartet and remove the fictional passing plan.
TRAINER_JOHN_AND_JAY_1.acceptance: Test Tail Glow plus Bug Buzz, Encore denial and Illumise Wish healing a replacement; verify no Baton Pass is advertised.
TRAINER_JOHN_AND_JAY_1.proposed_crack: Rock/Flying pressure the bugs and Dark/Electric pressure Slowbro. Taunt can limit Volbeat's self-boosting Tail Glow and Encore; there is no Baton Pass chain in this authored team.
