TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_1.assessment: Sandygast/Torkoal places Water Compaction bulk beside Drought/Eruption; Mawile Intimidate/setup and Simple Numel extend the physical/special mix. Water Compaction raises Defense but does not grant Water immunity; sun reduces that incoming damage.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_1.acceptance: Test surviving Water damage before Defense boost, sun-modified Eruption and Simple Amnesia producing doubled stat stages.

TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_2.assessment: Krookodile/Sandaconda creates Intimidate, Glare and Coil pressure, with Salazzle/Houndoom special reserves. Sand Spit can chip those reserves and does not boost their damage. Keep the intentionally mixed faction team and ensure entry/attack choices respect weather.
TRAINER_GRUNT_MT_CHIMNEY_2.acceptance: Test Sand Spit activation, Glare on Ground types, Corrosion Toxic and Coil's damage/accuracy effects.

TRAINER_TABITHA_MT_CHIMNEY.assessment: Coalossal/Klang is immediate coverage plus Shift Gear, with Gas Weezing, Specs Magmortar, Rhyperior and Mega Houndoom. Gas suppresses friendly Steam Engine, Clear Body, Solid Rock and relevant Mega abilities; preserve the deliberate option but model its opportunity cost.
TRAINER_TABITHA_MT_CHIMNEY.acceptance: Test Coalossal Water hit survival versus knockout, Gas entering before/after Steam Engine and reserve choices when suppression hurts the active partner.

TRAINER_MAXIE_MT_CHIMNEY.assessment: Ninetales/Crobat leads with sun and Tailwind, then Intimidate Mightyena/Arbok, Fake Out Shiftry and signature Mega Camerupt. All six have coherent roles. Mega Camerupt remains slow even under Tailwind; exact order must guide AI rather than a presumed universal speed solution.
TRAINER_MAXIE_MT_CHIMNEY.acceptance: Trace Chlorophyll after sun changes, Howl affecting a physical partner, dual Intimidate replacement and Camerupt Sheer Force damage.

TRAINER_ERIC.assessment: Boldore/Metang offers defense-to-offense setup and Occa-protected physical attacks, with Bronzong screens and Claydol support. Two hazard users are reserves rather than simultaneous mandatory setters; redundancy is useful if the first falls.
TRAINER_ERIC.acceptance: Test Stealth Rock at existing maximum, Occa consumption, Body Press after Iron Defense and Heatproof versus Levitate matchups.

TRAINER_GRUNT_JAGGED_PASS.assessment: Blacephalon's Beast Boost pressure is protected by Stunfisk's Yawn/trap/hazards, with Stakeout Thievul and Corrosion Salazzle providing alternate punishment. Preserve the unusual powerful grunt under the agreed premise. Trapping and Stakeout apply to different targets/times, not an automatic same-target combo.
TRAINER_GRUNT_JAGGED_PASS.acceptance: Test Yawn forcing switches before trapping, Stakeout only on switched targets and terrain changing Mimicry's typing.

TRAINER_DIANA_1.assessment: Delibird's Fake Out/Icy Wind supports Specs Eelektross; Flare Boost Gourgeist and Gem Jumpluff create special versus physical reserve pressure. Levitate removes ordinary Ground weakness but can be bypassed; retain this collector composition.
TRAINER_DIANA_1.acceptance: Test Freeze-Dry against Water, Eelektross under Mold Breaker and Gourgeist burn/Flare Boost sustain.

TRAINER_AUTUMN.assessment: Hariyama/Avalugg opens with Fake Out enabling a bulky Policy attacker; Chesnaught and Sawsbuck offer contact defense and Helping Hand. This is Autumn's own four-member battle. Guts means burning Hariyama is not defensive counterplay.
TRAINER_AUTUMN.acceptance: Test Fake Out support for Avalugg, Sturdy/Policy after a super-effective hit and Bulletproof move immunity.

TRAINER_JULIO.assessment: Specs Haunter/Life Orb Jolteon applies fast special pressure, with Band Dodrio and Shed Tail Cyclizar adding physical offense or protection. Ground cannot hit Levitate Haunter or Flying Dodrio without bypass. Preserve speed identity while fixing broad advice.
TRAINER_JULIO.acceptance: Test Jolteon pivot timing, Haunter immunity and legal Shed Tail recipient selection.
TRAINER_JULIO.proposed_crack: Ground threatens Jolteon, but Levitate Haunter and Flying Dodrio avoid it under normal conditions. Dark/Ghost pressure Haunter, Rock/Electric pressure Dodrio, and Choice locks offer positioning opportunities without assuming the entire team shares one weakness.

TRAINER_ETHAN_1.assessment: Bouffalant/Rillaboom pairs bulky physical offense with Grassy priority and speed drops; Cacturne and Dhelmise add immunity/trapping. Flying targets resist Grass but do not remove Grassy Glide's priority. Preserve the team and correct the field rule.
TRAINER_ETHAN_1.acceptance: Test Grassy Glide into grounded versus Flying targets under terrain, Drum Beating order and terrain replacement.
TRAINER_ETHAN_1.proposed_crack: Fighting pressures Bouffalant, while Fire/Flying pressure Rillaboom and other Grass members. A Flying target resists Grass but does not cancel Grassy Glide priority; remove terrain or use applicable priority denial to change that interaction.

TRAINER_LUCY_LAVARIDGE.assessment: Shuckle/Seviper preserves Lucy's signature snake and Milotic while Drapion and Mega Absol create a dangerous back half. Sticky Web, Glare and Helping Hand are legitimate support options. Drapion is neutral to Fire/Rock, so broad shared weakness text is misleading.
TRAINER_LUCY_LAVARIDGE.acceptance: Test Web versus airborne reserves, Sniper critical multipliers, Milotic Haze not unnecessarily removing allied boosts and Magic Bounce after Mega.
TRAINER_LUCY_LAVARIDGE.proposed_crack: Rock/Water/Steel pressure Shuckle, while Ground threatens Seviper and Drapion. Electric/Grass pressure Milotic and Fighting/Fairy pressure Absol; Flying and Levitate ignore Sticky Web. Do not rely on Fire/Rock as super-effective Drapion coverage.

TRAINER_SHELBY_1.assessment: Wobbuffet/Slowbro builds trapping and sustain before Policy Aegislash and Mega Medicham. Wide Guard and King's Shield have distinct purposes; Aegislash is Dark-weak in both stances, though its defenses change. Preserve the highly coherent specialist team.
TRAINER_SHELBY_1.acceptance: Test form change ordering, both guards against relevant attacks, Policy survival and High Jump Kick into Protect or Ghost.

TRAINER_MELISSA.assessment: Toxic Orb Lopunny can Fake Out or Switcheroo beside Liquid Voice Primarina, with Trace Gardevoir and Competitive Wigglytuff providing alternative special pressure. Switcheroo must consider immunities, already-statused targets and nonexchangeable items; a blanket best-Pokémon target is wrong.
TRAINER_MELISSA.acceptance: Test Switcheroo into Mega Stones, Poison/Steel, existing status and Protect; verify Throat Spray after Liquid Voice.

TRAINER_SHEILA.assessment: Tsareena's priority denial protects King's Rock/Skill Link Cinccino, with Overcoat Escavalier and Wormadam providing setup reserves. Flinch chance is useful only before a target acts; preserve this timing-sensitive physical/special mix.
TRAINER_SHEILA.acceptance: Test per-hit King's Rock resolution, priority denial and powder immunity on both Overcoat reserves.

TRAINER_SHIRLEY.assessment: Alcremie Decorate/Helping Hand supports Scarf Mr. Mime, then Sylveon or Slowbro. Decorate is slower than the Scarf lead, so its first boost usually pays off next turn; Helping Hand offers immediate gain. Aroma Veil and Screen Cleaner have distinct field consequences.
TRAINER_SHIRLEY.acceptance: Compare immediate Helping Hand versus delayed Decorate, no boosting a departing partner and Screen Cleaner removing both sides' screens.

TRAINER_SAWYER_1.assessment: Smooth Rock Gigalith/Excadrill is a coherent sand engine with Camerupt special coverage and Donphan removal in reserve. The crack's five-turn sand is incorrect because the setter holds Smooth Rock.
TRAINER_SAWYER_1.acceptance: Test eight-turn sand, same-turn Sand Rush changes and Donphan Sand Veil only while sand is active.
TRAINER_SAWYER_1.proposed_crack: Water/Grass pressure Gigalith and Fire/Fighting/Ground pressure Excadrill. Smooth Rock extends this sand to eight turns; weather replacement can remove Sand Rush immediately, while the reserves retain useful attacks outside sand.

TRAINER_COLE.assessment: Magcargo/Torracat leads with special coverage, recovery and Intimidate; Fletchinder contact punishment, Simple Numel, Specs Litleo and Tough Claws Heatmor are distinct reserves. The existing team is more sophisticated than its dismissive first-stage crack suggests.
TRAINER_COLE.acceptance: Test Flame Body chance versus guaranteed Helmet damage, Simple Amnesia and reserve selection against special offense.
TRAINER_COLE.proposed_crack: Noncontact attacks avoid Helmet and Flame Body contact triggers, while appropriate Water/Ground/Rock coverage threatens individual Fire members. Check actual typing and bulk; this roster includes evolved Pokémon and meaningful special-defense support.

TRAINER_GERALD.assessment: Sunflora/Victreebel runs eight-turn manual sun, Scovillain adds boosted Growth, and Simisear/Pyroar/Charizard X diversify offense. Only Chlorophyll holders gain speed; Charizard remains Fire after gaining Dragon. Preserve composition and correct overbroad sun claims.
TRAINER_GERALD.acceptance: Test Heat Rock duration, Growth under sun and Charizard X typing/Water neutrality with and without sun.

TRAINER_AXLE.assessment: Armarouge/Turtonator offers special offense with conditional Policy and Shell Armor, followed by speed activation and physical Fire reserves. Turtonator has no Shell Trap and does not explode upon contact; Water remains dangerous to Coalossal even when it triggers speed.
TRAINER_AXLE.acceptance: Test super-effective Policy only on survival, Steam Engine damage before speed gain and Shell Armor blocking crits without invented retaliation.
TRAINER_AXLE.proposed_crack: Direct knockouts prevent activation payoffs; status and positioning can avoid feeding boosts. Weak Armor lowers Ceruledge's Defense while raising Speed. Turtonator has Shell Armor and no Shell Trap, so physical hits do not trigger a shell explosion.

TRAINER_KEEGAN.assessment: Guts Flareon/Vigoroth gives immediate orb offense and Bulk Up, with recoil Emboar, HP-sensitive Typhlosion and special Fire reserves. Recoil creates meaningful cost but is not a guarantee the player can wait out damage. Preserve complete sets.
TRAINER_KEEGAN.acceptance: Trace Toxic Orb/Guts, Eruption at different HP and Houndoom choosing setup only with a safe useful turn.

TRAINER_DANIELLE.assessment: Oricorio can use its own Quiver Dance while Kubfu attacks; Sizzlipede, Rotom-Heat, Delphox and Mega Blaziken broaden damage. Refusing to use dance moves does not prevent Oricorio setup. Its copied Swords Dance is incidental to its special role.
TRAINER_DANIELLE.acceptance: Test self Quiver Dance, Dancer copying without infinite loops, and Mega Blaziken Speed Boost plus setup under pressure.
TRAINER_DANIELLE.proposed_crack: Oricorio can boost itself with Quiver Dance even if the player never dances. Rock pressure and timely disruption can limit it; suitable Water/Psychic attacks threaten Blaziken, but Protect, Speed Boost and the other reserves create alternative lines.

TRAINER_ELI.assessment: Claydol/Heatproof Bronzong supplies hazards/screens for Mega Camerupt and three offensive Fire reserves. Heatproof Bronzong is grounded; Camerupt does not counter Water simply by Mega evolving. Preserve the actual defensive/offensive roles and fix the explanation.
TRAINER_ELI.acceptance: Test Ground hitting Heatproof Bronzong, Fire damage reduction and Camerupt's retained fourfold Water weakness after Mega.

TRAINER_JACE.assessment: Salazzle/Larvesta combines Corrosion and physical sustain, then Lampent burns and Alolan Marowak attacks before the Hisuian double aces. Poison or burn supports Infernal Parade, but no unnecessary overwrite is possible once a target is statused. Preserve the six.
TRAINER_JACE.acceptance: Test Toxic into Steel, Infernal Parade on poison/burn and last-two ace locks for Arcanine/Typhlosion.

TRAINER_JEFF.assessment: Drifblim/Crobat actually leads, followed by Infernape, Scarf Darmanitan and Band Cinderace before Talonflame's locked ace. This is coherent mixed pressure. Gale Wings can reactivate if Roost restores full HP; Libero is once per entry.
TRAINER_JEFF.acceptance: Test actual lead order, Libero reset by U-turn and Gale Wings returning at full HP after Roost.

TRAINER_FLANNERY_1.assessment: Torkoal/Lilligant's After You Eruption is already an excellent expert puzzle with iconic Torkoal central. Incineroar protects repeated action windows; Skeledirge, Entei and Mega Chandelure offer distinct finishers. Preserve all loadouts. Native defeat text mentions a nonexistent Balloon and assumes a specific solution.
TRAINER_FLANNERY_1.acceptance: Test After You order under sun/Room, Eruption versus Heat Wave after chip, Parting Shot utility, Mega Chandelure legality and outcome-neutral victory dialogue.

TRAINER_DREW.assessment: Stakataka/Golurk has meaningful Room and Wide Guard support, while Cacturne supplies priority and Perrserker Steel boosting/Fake Out. Preserve Stakataka despite ordinary rank. Its Defense investment favors defensive Beast Boost rather than an invented Attack snowball.
TRAINER_DREW.acceptance: Test Trick Room versus slower foes, Wide Guard, Beast Boost selected stat and Steely Spirit increasing Gyro Ball.

TRAINER_HEIDI.assessment: Shaymin special pressure complements Contrary Lurantis and bulky Mudsdale; Parasect supplies a status/Water-absorption reserve. The oasis roster supports several strategies without forced speed uniformity. Preserve the current four.
TRAINER_HEIDI.acceptance: Test Contrary Superpower raises, Seed Flare stat drops and Stamina versus special attacks.

TRAINER_BEAU.assessment: Kartana/Gastrodon combines Sash offense, Storm Drain and Icy Wind; Lycanroc priority and Archeops burst are credible reserves. Preserve the exotic core. A single Fire hit does not defeat full-HP Sash Kartana unless Sash is bypassed or already broken.
TRAINER_BEAU.acceptance: Test Focus Sash, Rindo berry versus Grass, Storm Drain and Beast Boost after a knockout.
TRAINER_BEAU.proposed_crack: Fire is devastating to Kartana, but an intact Focus Sash can preserve it. Grass strongly threatens Gastrodon after accounting for Rindo Berry; Water/Grass/Fighting pressure Lycanroc, and chip can activate Archeops's Defeatist.

TRAINER_DUSTY_1.assessment: Ting-Lu's defensive aura reduces other Pokémon's SpA by one quarter, including Sigilyph and Aurorus. That is a real tradeoff for survivability, not a half-power aura. Bastiodon's Metal Burst/Chesto Rest offers another defensive route. Preserve roster with honest aura modeling.
TRAINER_DUSTY_1.acceptance: Measure 0.75 aura modifier on ally/enemy special attacks, Ruination and Metal Burst damage after actual received hits.

TRAINER_DAISUKE.assessment: Medicham Fake Out supports Lucario's Swords Dance, with bulky Bewear and Annihilape keeping physical pressure varied. Lucario's Steel typing makes Flying/Psychic/Fairy neutral rather than universal weaknesses; Guts is absent so burn remains relevant where legal.
TRAINER_DAISUKE.acceptance: Test Fake Out enabling setup, Lucario Extreme Speed versus terrain and Rage Fist hit counting.
TRAINER_DAISUKE.proposed_crack: Flying pressures Medicham/Bewear/Annihilape, while Lucario is neutral to Flying, Psychic and Fairy and weak to Fire/Ground/Fighting. Respect Fluffy's contact reduction and Fire drawback, and avoid feeding repeated weak hits into Rage Fist.

TRAINER_ALANNAH.assessment: Celebi/Trevenant blends Natural Cure pivoting with configured Grassy Surge; Mega Venusaur supplies Thick Fat durability and Gourgeist special burn offense. Preserve the thematic team. Generic Fire/Ice advice must be adjusted after Venusaur Mega evolves.
TRAINER_ALANNAH.acceptance: Test Grassy healing both sides, Poltergeist item requirement, Mega Thick Fat and Natural Cure on pivot.

TRAINER_MARTIN.assessment: Drought Ninetales/Leafeon gives immediate sun speed, with Flash Fire Centiskorch and Water Absorb Cacturne as defensive-offensive reserves. Both reserves offer useful paths outside sun, so weather denial should not imply the whole team stops functioning.
TRAINER_MARTIN.acceptance: Test sun replacement changing Chlorophyll immediately and reserve immunity selection against Water/Fire attacks.

TRAINER_ROMAN.assessment: Buzzwole/Starmie mixes physical Beast Boost and fast speed control; Sturdy/Policy Golem and Lightning Rod Rhydon are substantial reserves. Grass activates Golem's Policy if it survives, contradicting the crack; Buzzwole has no draining move in its actual set.
TRAINER_ROMAN.acceptance: Test Icy Wind changing order, Golem Sturdy/Policy on Grass and Rhydon redirecting Electric from Starmie.
TRAINER_ROMAN.proposed_crack: Flying strongly threatens Buzzwole, and Dark/Electric pressure Starmie unless Lightning Rod intervenes. Grass is fourfold effective against Golem and Rhydon, but a surviving Sturdy Golem activates Weakness Policy; plan its follow-up.

TRAINER_ELMER.assessment: Wo-Chien and Intimidate Masquerain suppress physical pressure while Quiver Dance develops special offense; Araquanid's Water Bubble and Bronzong Body Press remain useful despite Tablets of Ruin. There is no Trick Room in the set.
TRAINER_ELMER.acceptance: Test aura on Araquanid Attack but not Body Press, Water Bubble damage and Wide Guard beside setup.
TRAINER_ELMER.proposed_crack: Bug/Fire/Flying pressure Wo-Chien or Masquerain according to typing; Electric/Rock pressure Araquanid. Bronzong has Levitate and Light Screen, not Trick Room. Taunt limits Quiver Dance, seeding and screens while single-target attacks bypass Wide Guard.

TRAINER_JUSTIN.assessment: Kecleon Fake Out supports Contrary Malamar, with Bouffalant and Cacturne providing sturdy offense or Water immunity. Topsy-Turvy is powerful only when reversing the target's net stages is beneficial. Protean changes Kecleon's defensive typing once per entry.
TRAINER_JUSTIN.acceptance: Test Contrary Superpower/Intimidate, Topsy-Turvy avoiding an already-debuffed target and Protean timing after Fake Out.

TRAINER_MARTHA.assessment: Meowstic/Clefable has dual special setup, while Mega Banette adds priority disruption and Gourgeist burn offense. Banette's Knock Off removes items that Poltergeist requires, so the AI must use those options according to future utility. Preserve move flexibility.
TRAINER_MARTHA.acceptance: Test Prankster into Dark targets, Destiny Bond timing and Poltergeist after the target loses its item.

TRAINER_ALAN.assessment: Rhydon/Palossand supplies Electric redirection and physical resilience before Mega Aggron and Sturdy/Policy Golem. Water Compaction boosts Defense after damage without granting immunity; Mega Aggron becomes pure Steel and resists Grass. Preserve roster and correct advice.
TRAINER_ALAN.acceptance: Test Water damage before Compaction, Filter after Mega typing change and Sturdy/Policy Golem.
TRAINER_ALAN.proposed_crack: Grass strongly threatens Rhydon/Golem and pressures Palossand, but Mega Aggron resists Grass. Water still damages Palossand super effectively before Water Compaction raises Defense; special Water pressure can remain effective. Ground/Fighting threaten Aggron despite Filter.

TRAINER_RANDALL.assessment: Cinccino/Ambipom opens multihit pressure, with Maushold redirection and two bulky status reserves. Population Bomb is up to ten accuracy-checked hits and Maushold has Friend Guard, not Skill Link. Scarf Fake Out commits Ambipom to a switch afterward.
TRAINER_RANDALL.acceptance: Test Skill Link versus Population Bomb hit mechanics, Helmet/contact damage and intelligent switching after Choice-locked Fake Out.

TRAINER_PARKER.assessment: Oranguru Room/Instruct supports Girafarig, then physical Spinda/Wyrdeer or special Farigiraf/Band Lickilicky. Instruct timing under Room needs exact order: it can repeat a prior move before a partner's scheduled action. Preserve the advanced interaction rather than assume one script.
TRAINER_PARKER.acceptance: Test Instruct under Room before/after partner action, Armor Tail limits and Room against naturally slower opponents.

TRAINER_GEORGE.assessment: Mega Audino/Dubwool combines Healer/partner healing with Cotton Guard Body Press; Chansey and Komala sustain while Band Miltank/AV Snorlax supply damage. The claim that nothing threatens the player is false; Mega also replaces Regenerator.
TRAINER_GEORGE.acceptance: Test Mega ability change, Body Press after Cotton Guard, healing score versus an immediate knockout and Comatose status handling.
TRAINER_GEORGE.proposed_crack: Taunt and strong suitable attacks can limit healing or Cotton Guard, but boosted Body Press, Band Miltank and Snorlax are real offensive threats. Fluffy reduces contact damage and increases Fire damage; calculate Chansey's physical survival instead of assuming a one-hit knockout.

TRAINER_BERKE.assessment: Scrappy Exploud/Mega Glalie creates special/physical spread-safe pressure; Cetitan and Perrserker support different coverage before locked Stoutland/Kangaskhan. Refrigerate converts Facade into Ice and Steelworker support applies only to actual Steel attacks. Preserve exact ordering.
TRAINER_BERKE.acceptance: Test Refrigerate typing, Scrappy into Ghost, Steely Spirit with eligible moves and double-ace reserve release.

TRAINER_MARY.assessment: Drampa/Rufflet, orb Obstagoon, Coil Dudunsparce, Silvally and Mega Lopunny is a strong retaliation roster. Rufflet's Sheer Force benefits none of its attacks; change only that ability to legal Hustle for real physical pressure, retaining the accuracy cost. Berserk raises SpA one stage when crossing half HP, including a single surviving hit.
TRAINER_MARY.acceptance: Compare Rufflet damage/accuracy before and after ability repair; test Berserk at exact HP thresholds and Mega Lopunny's final ability.

TRAINER_ALEXIA.assessment: Orb Zangoose/Ursaring leads with immediate physical pressure; Sitrus Linoone, Simple Bibarel, Scarf Delcatty and Ursaluna offer distinct reserve routes. Delcatty actually has Wonder Skin, not Normalize, and Belly Drum plus Sitrus does not leave Linoone at a quarter HP.
TRAINER_ALEXIA.acceptance: Test both orbs, exact Drum/Sitrus HP, Simple Curse including Speed loss and Wonder Skin against status accuracy.
TRAINER_ALEXIA.proposed_crack: Orb users take residual damage but gain substantial offense. Linoone normally recovers with Sitrus immediately after Belly Drum; calculate its remaining HP. Delcatty has Wonder Skin, so its Fairy/Psychic/Electric coverage retains those types instead of becoming Normal.

TRAINER_JODY.assessment: Intimidate Tauros and Mega Pinsir leads physical pressure, with Sawsbuck, Bouffalant and Band Diggersby before Specs Porygon-Z's locked ace. Mega Pinsir replaces Moxie with Aerilate, so it does not gain Moxie after Mega knockouts. Preserve roster and actual ability transition.
TRAINER_JODY.acceptance: Test pre-Mega Moxie versus post-Mega Aerilate, Facade typing and Porygon-Z final ace release.
TRAINER_JODY.proposed_crack: Use target-specific resistance, Intimidate and suitable coverage while accounting for Sawsbuck's Sap Sipper. Mega Pinsir gains Aerilate rather than retaining Moxie; Diggersby's Choice lock and the late Porygon-Z special threat require different defensive answers.

TRAINER_NORMAN_1.assessment: Indeedee/Porygon2 supports bulky attackers through terrain/redirection and Icy Wind; iconic Slaking remains a major Band attacker before Mega Staraptor. Giga Impact/Truant interaction is deliberate and must be simulated exactly. Preserve all six; no nostalgia replacement is necessary.
TRAINER_NORMAN_1.acceptance: Test terrain priority by grounded target, Truant with Giga Impact recharge, Fluffy contact rules and Mega Staraptor's actual ability change.

TRAINER_CORA.assessment: Toxicroak/Mienshao uses Fake Out to enable Swords Dance, with Defiant Annihilape and Iron Fist Gurdurr maintaining physical options. Fairy is neutral on Poison/Fighting Toxicroak; Rage Fist damage history persists through switches in the modern ruleset.
TRAINER_CORA.acceptance: Test Fake Out/setup coordination, Defiant on entry and Rage Fist hit count after switching out/back.
TRAINER_CORA.proposed_crack: Psychic/Flying pressure the opening, but Toxicroak takes neutral Fairy damage. Avoid careless Intimidate against Defiant Annihilape and repeated weak hits that charge Rage Fist; switching does not erase its accumulated hit count.

TRAINER_YUJI.assessment: Bulky Type: Null Icy Wind supports Scrafty Fake Out/Quick Guard, followed by Hariyama or mixed Lucario. Battle Armor makes Null resistant to critical bypass rather than simply stat-heavy. Preserve the unusual support role and prepared mixed Lucario.
TRAINER_YUJI.acceptance: Test Quick Guard against priority, Battle Armor crit prevention and Icy Wind improving the chosen reserve's order.

TRAINER_PAULA.assessment: Breloom's Spore/Substitute/Focus Punch is supported by Pangoro Parting Shot, with Drum Poliwrath and Band Crabominable providing reserve power. Focus Punch is conditional on avoiding damaging hits; Sitrus repairs much of Drum's HP cost.
TRAINER_PAULA.acceptance: Test Focus Punch behind Substitute, Poison Heal timing, Parting Shot versus immunity and exact Poliwrath Drum/Sitrus HP.
TRAINER_PAULA.proposed_crack: Flying pressures the Fighting roster and Fire pressures Breloom; powder immunity and multi-action pressure can disrupt Substitute/Focus Punch. Poliwrath's Sitrus heals immediately after Belly Drum, so calculate its survival rather than assuming half-HP vulnerability.

TRAINER_FOSTER.assessment: Omastar/Runerigus pairs Smash offense with burns, followed by Mega Slowbro sustain and Band Relicanth immediate damage. No Trick Room is present; that absence intentionally avoids reversing Omastar's speed. Preserve the corrected plan and remove stale crack text.
TRAINER_FOSTER.acceptance: Test White Herb versus Weak Armor effects, Wandering Spirit on contact and Mega Slowbro Calm Mind after Omastar falls.
TRAINER_FOSTER.proposed_crack: Ghost/Dark pressure Runerigus and Slowbro, and Grass is especially dangerous to Omastar/Relicanth. Taunt can stop setup, healing or burn support; this team has no Trick Room to interrupt.

TRAINER_LUIS.assessment: Lanturn/Mantine uses Surf to heal the partner and Tailwind to support offense. Arctovish is also Surf-safe; Sharpedo is not immune despite resistance. Preserve the intentional activation route while making reserve-aware Surf choice mandatory.
TRAINER_LUIS.acceptance: Test Surf with Lanturn, Arctovish and Sharpedo, plus Tailwind improving Fishious Rend's action order.

TRAINER_BEVERLY.assessment: Electric Terrain supports Alolan Raichu but blocks grounded Quagsire's Yawn targets, an important conditional reserve limitation. Merciless Toxapex is a poison-based threat; Poison opponents still take neutral Venoshock, while Steel is immune. Preserve roster with field-aware status AI.
TRAINER_BEVERLY.acceptance: Test Yawn against grounded targets during/after terrain and Merciless/Venoshock on poisoned versus unpoisoned foes.
TRAINER_BEVERLY.proposed_crack: Ground pressures the Electric lead and Toxapex; Grass strongly threatens Quagsire. Steel blocks Toxapex's Poison attack, but Poison types are not universally immune to Venoshock. Electric Terrain prevents sleep on grounded targets while it lasts.

TRAINER_IMANI.assessment: Kingdra's Focus Energy/Sniper plan is supported by Milotic's actual Icy Wind, not the Haze mentioned in prose. Swanna supplies coverage and Cloud Nine Golduck answers weather. Preserve this crit-focused team and its weather-independent route.
TRAINER_IMANI.acceptance: Test Focus Energy/Scope Lens crit threshold, Draco Meteor crit after SpA drops and Cloud Nine's suppression without deleting weather.

TRAINER_JOSUE.assessment: Pelipper/Cramorant establishes rain with Surf/Gulp Missile, then Wind Power Kilowattrel and Prankster Tornadus. No ally has Water immunity: Cramorant's Surf must consider significant friendly damage, especially on the non-Water birds. Preserve the signature move with accurate scoring.
TRAINER_JOSUE.acceptance: Trace Gulp Missile HP-dependent forms and Surf allied damage, Wind Power on Tailwind and Damp Rock duration.

TRAINER_ANDRES_1.assessment: Relicanth/Armaldo provides strong physical fossil offense, with Omastar setup and Bastiodon defensive retaliation. Grass is neutral on Rock/Bug Armaldo rather than a universal weakness. Preserve the four distinct roles.
TRAINER_ANDRES_1.acceptance: Test Rock Head recoil suppression, White Herb Smash and Metal Burst's actual damage target.
TRAINER_ANDRES_1.proposed_crack: Grass strongly threatens Relicanth and Omastar but is neutral against Armaldo. Water/Rock/Steel pressure Armaldo, while Ground/Fighting are especially dangerous to Bastiodon; account for Setup and Choice locks.

TRAINER_KYLA.assessment: Nidoqueen/Golduck supplies recoil-free Sheer Force damage and weather suppression, with Toxapex poison sustain and Competitive Milotic as reserves. All four are credible, with very different responses to stat drops and status.
TRAINER_KYLA.acceptance: Test each Nidoqueen attack's Sheer Force/Life Orb interaction, Cloud Nine and Milotic entry into Intimidate.

TRAINER_DARRIN.assessment: Politoed/Kingdra has eight-turn rain plus Helping Hand/Icy Wind, then Rotom, Barraskewda, Ludicolo and Mega Gyarados. Preserve this complete rain team. Damp Rock, Water/Dragon/Grass resistances and Mega Water/Dark typing invalidate the generic Electric/Grass/Ice crack.
TRAINER_DARRIN.acceptance: Test eight-turn rain, same-turn Swift Swim, Mold Breaker through Water Absorb and Mega Gyarados typing.
TRAINER_DARRIN.proposed_crack: Replace rain or control speed through another field state; Damp Rock makes it last eight turns. Electric is neutral on Kingdra/Ludicolo and resisted by Rotom-Wash, while Mega Gyarados is only twofold Electric-weak and resists Ice. Use target-specific coverage and pressure its setup window.

TRAINER_TONY_1.assessment: Golisopod/Dewgong combines Emergency Exit pressure with configured Fur Coat and Encore; Floatzel and Empoleon supply fast physical versus Competitive special reserves. The plan's Thick Fat Dewgong is stale. Sitrus can affect whether the exit threshold remains crossed.
TRAINER_TONY_1.acceptance: Test Sitrus/Emergency Exit ordering, Fur Coat damage, First Impression on re-entry and Competitive Empoleon.

TRAINER_DENISE.assessment: Swanna's Tailwind is protected by Seaking's Lightning Rod; Quagsire and Toxapex offer sustain alternatives. Ground immunity and redirection mean Electric is not a simple lead answer. Rock is neutral on pure-Water Seaking.
TRAINER_DENISE.acceptance: Test Electric redirection from Swanna, speed after Tailwind and Quagsire Yawn with poison-plan Toxapex.
TRAINER_DENISE.proposed_crack: Seaking's Lightning Rod protects Swanna from ordinary single-target Electric attacks. Grass strongly threatens Quagsire and pressures Seaking; Rock threatens Swanna but is neutral on Seaking. Remove the redirector or use appropriate bypassing pressure.

TRAINER_LISA_AND_RAY.assessment: Clawitzer/Dragalge splits boosted pulses and Adaptability Dragon pressure; Bruxish supplies priority denial and Scarf Dracovish immediate conditional burst. Preserve the quartet and its slower opening versus faster reserve contrast.
TRAINER_LISA_AND_RAY.acceptance: Test Dazzling on entry, Fishious Rend action-order doubling and Mega Launcher/Adaptability applying to correct moves.

TRAINER_CAMRON.assessment: Starmie/Arctovish offers immediate speed and mixed coverage, with Fur Coat Dewgong speed support and Golisopod priority. Arctovish's low Speed means Rend is conditional until Icy Wind support arrives; Freeze-Dry remains independently useful.
TRAINER_CAMRON.acceptance: Compare Rend before/after Icy Wind, mixed damage targets and Emergency Exit replacement rules.

TRAINER_TARA.assessment: Seadra setup is protected indirectly by threatening Sheer Force Feraligatr; Thermal Exchange Arctibax and Competitive Milotic add different punishment mechanisms. Preserve the coordinated threat diversity rather than insisting every setup needs redirection.
TRAINER_TARA.acceptance: Test crit setup window, Sheer Force recoil suppression and Thermal Exchange's burn immunity/Fire-triggered Attack gain.

TRAINER_MISSY.assessment: Pyukumuku's Soak can remove Steel's Poison immunity before Toxic, supporting Cloyster setup; Seaking and Kingdra supply redirection or crit offense. Thus Steel alone does not end the poison plan. Preserve this clever interaction.
TRAINER_MISSY.acceptance: Test Soak then Toxic into Steel, Water immunity not blocking Soak incorrectly, and White Herb Cloyster.
TRAINER_MISSY.proposed_crack: Taunt can shut down Pyukumuku's all-status set, but Steel alone is insufficient because Soak can replace its typing before Toxic. Pressure Cloyster's setup with suitable damage while respecting White Herb and Seaking's Lightning Rod.

TRAINER_CAROLINA.assessment: Hawlucha/Luxray combines Intimidate and White Herb Unburden, with Mega Gardevoir then locked-ace Kommo-o. Actual ace order differs from prose claiming Gardevoir closes. Preserve order and describe Kommo-o's Iron Defense/Body Press endgame.
TRAINER_CAROLINA.acceptance: Test White Herb/Acrobatics, Luxray pivot, Mega Gardevoir coverage against Poison and Kommo-o ace timing.

TRAINER_CORY_1.assessment: Stunfisk Yawn supports Poliwrath physical pressure, with Lanturn special coverage and Vikavolt Electroweb as reserves. The lack of initial speed control is an authored bulky lead choice, with later control available.
TRAINER_CORY_1.acceptance: Test Yawn pressure, Electroweb changing replacement order and Levitate/Water Absorb on reserve entry.

TRAINER_CHARLIE.assessment: Wailord's HP-sensitive spread offense pairs with AV Octillery coverage, then Starmie or Sniper Inteleon. Snipe Shot's redirection exception gives Inteleon a specific role. Preserve the offensive Water identity and item diversity.
TRAINER_CHARLIE.acceptance: Test Sitrus restoring Water Spout power, Snipe Shot bypassing redirection and crit/Sniper thresholds.

TRAINER_DUNCAN.assessment: Mega Machamp uses the build's custom Power Fists while Walrein supplies Encore and special bulk; Dhelmise and Decidueye trap with different attacks. Walrein is already competitively meaningful here. Preserve team and require exact custom mechanic verification.
TRAINER_DUNCAN.acceptance: Test Power Fists using the documented defensive stat and accuracy rules, Walrein Encore timing and trapping escape exceptions.

TRAINER_KIRA_AND_DAN_1.assessment: Plusle/Minun supports paired Electric offense and pivoting, with Policy Solrock and Power Herb Lunatone as distinct reserves. The meteorites share Levitate but differ in damage category; preserve this clear paired identity.
TRAINER_KIRA_AND_DAN_1.acceptance: Test Plus/Minus loss after pivot, Policy survival and one-turn Meteor Beam plus SpA boost.

TRAINER_JANI.assessment: Dragonair/Simipour offers physical and special setup, with Band Furret immediate pressure and Simple Bibarel priority. The AI must avoid both leads taking unsafe setup turns simultaneously. Preserve complete sets and treat Outrage locking as a real cost.
TRAINER_JANI.acceptance: Test mutually compatible lead actions, Simple +4 Swords Dance and Outrage targeting/lock rules.

TRAINER_GARRISON.assessment: Galvanize Alolan Golem threatens while Carracosta sets up; Relicanth and Armaldo provide recoil-free burst or additional setup. White Herb means Carracosta's defense drops do not remain after Smash. Preserve roster and correct that repeated prose error.
TRAINER_GARRISON.acceptance: Test Galvanize and recoil, White Herb defense restoration and Battle Armor preventing critical bypass.
TRAINER_GARRISON.proposed_crack: Ground is fourfold effective against Alolan Golem and Grass strongly threatens Carracosta/Relicanth. Carracosta retains restored defenses after White Herb; calculate the knockout and account for Sturdy instead of assuming any strong hit succeeds.

TRAINER_DEMETRIUS.assessment: Stoutland/Electivire applies physical pressure and coverage, with Magnezone/Lanturn special alternatives. Scrappy helps Normal attacks hit Ghost; Crunch could already do so. Motor Drive is defensive against opposing Electric, not an ally-trigger engine in this set.
TRAINER_DEMETRIUS.acceptance: Test Scrappy Double-Edge into Ghost, Motor Drive on an opposing attack and Analytic Magneton against switching.

TRAINER_THALIA_1.assessment: Florges protects Grass Tsareena through Flower Veil and Wish; Tsareena blocks priority and pivots into Primarina/Gardevoir special pressure. This is a well-integrated support ecology. Preserve all four and ensure immunity support follows the actual active partner.
TRAINER_THALIA_1.acceptance: Test Flower Veil versus Grass/non-Grass partners, Wish after U-turn and Liquid Voice/Throat Spray.

TRAINER_DAVID.assessment: Greninja/Policy Palossand creates direct special damage and conditional Water Compaction, with Competitive Empoleon and Speed Boost Sharpedo as reserves. Gen9 Protean is once per entry. Water is still super-effective against Palossand and can knock it out before benefits apply.
TRAINER_DAVID.acceptance: Test Water damage, Policy and Compaction ordering; confirm Protean only once and no false water-immunity prediction.

TRAINER_ALICE.assessment: Corsola's burns/Strength Sap support Cloyster's Smash, with Crawdaunt priority and Kingdra crit offense in reserve. This is a coherent physical-mitigation setup team; Taunt affects several options without disabling every attacker.
TRAINER_ALICE.acceptance: Test Strength Sap versus stat-drop immunity, White Herb Cloyster and Focus Energy/crit behavior after Draco Meteor drops.

TRAINER_AUSTINA.assessment: Simple Bibarel/Eiscue combines two different setup routes; Simipour and Walrein provide special alternatives. Ice Face protects only against qualifying physical attacks and Sitrus repairs Drum HP. Electric is neutral on pure-Ice Eiscue.
TRAINER_AUSTINA.acceptance: Test physical versus special Ice Face hits, Noice speed change and exact Sitrus/Drum HP.
TRAINER_AUSTINA.proposed_crack: Fighting pressures Bibarel/Eiscue, while Electric threatens Bibarel but is neutral against pure-Ice Eiscue. Special pressure bypasses Ice Face, and timely disruption can deny setup; calculate Sitrus recovery before choosing a finisher.

TRAINER_CARTER.assessment: Whiscash setup pairs with immediate Scarf Dracovish, then Volt Absorb Lanturn and Intimidate Gyarados provide defensive pivots. Rend returns to ordinary power when second rather than becoming intrinsically half-powered; preserve the speed-focused quartet.
TRAINER_CARTER.acceptance: Test Rend before/after speed control, Rindo/Wacan survival and Intimidate reserve selection.

TRAINER_MEL_AND_PAUL.assessment: Illumise supports Mega Butterfree through Tailwind/Encore; Volbeat can pass boosts only to an eligible benched recipient, with Dustox as another special receiver. The plan is viable if Butterfree is benched, not while it remains the active partner.
TRAINER_MEL_AND_PAUL.acceptance: Test Baton Pass recipient eligibility, Quiver Dance versus immediate attacks and configured Mega Butterfree ability/damage.

TRAINER_DAISY.assessment: Cherrim's sun/Flower Gift boosts physical Deerling and team special resilience, while Roselia/Gloom add sleep and special coverage. Rock attacks do not remove sun; Cherrim's special spread is intentional support offense rather than Flower Gift self-synergy.
TRAINER_DAISY.acceptance: Test Flower Gift on both allies, Chlorophyll timing and sleep immunity; verify Heat Rock duration.
TRAINER_DAISY.proposed_crack: Replace or stall sun to remove Chlorophyll and Flower Gift benefits; Rock damage does not end weather. Fire/Flying pressure the Grass roster, while Grass types and other powder immunity prevent Sleep Powder.

TRAINER_AMY_AND_LIV_1.assessment: Togetic/Wigglytuff combines redirection and Throat Spray, with Mega Alakazam and Blissey providing speed offense or sustain. Competitive punishes careless drops; preserve the composition and avoid assuming Steel/Poison solves the whole board given Psychic coverage.
TRAINER_AMY_AND_LIV_1.acceptance: Test Follow Me with spread attacks, Mega Trace selection, Encore order and Blissey screen support.

TRAINER_MIGUEL_1.assessment: Delcatty Fake Out/paralysis supports Stantler, with bulky Lickitung and Curse Munchlax in reserve. Intimidate, Eviolite and recovery mean the generic claim of no bulk is too absolute. Preserve the actual competent ordinary team.
TRAINER_MIGUEL_1.acceptance: Test Helping Hand on the physical partner, Intimidate with Clear Amulet on Stantler and Curse Munchlax's speed/defense changes.

TRAINER_RHETT.assessment: Sawk/Throh offers Sturdy setup and guaranteed-critical Storm Throw, while Pawmo priority and Grapploct trapping extend the plan. Technician does not boost every Grapploct attack; its ordinary bulk and Octolock remain meaningful.
TRAINER_RHETT.acceptance: Test Sturdy after chip, Storm Throw against defense boosts and Octolock escape restrictions.

TRAINER_TIMOTHY_1.assessment: Dusclops/Hariyama uses Fake Out to establish Room, with Guts Conkeldurr and Mega Ampharos completing the slow roster. The actual Mega attack is Dragon Pulse, not the Draco Meteor named in prose. Preserve this complete classic doubles composition.
TRAINER_TIMOTHY_1.acceptance: Test Fake Out support, Pain Split evaluation, Room versus slower opponents and Mega Ampharos's exact four moves.

TRAINER_KOICHI.assessment: Mixed Lucario/Scarf Passimian creates immediate pressure, with Leek Sirfetch'd and Intimidate/Quick Guard Scrafty as reserves. Lucario's Steel typing neutralizes several Fighting-type weaknesses and Scrafty is Psychic-immune; counterplay must be target-specific.
TRAINER_KOICHI.acceptance: Test Defiant after Intimidate, Quick Guard protecting against priority and mixed Lucario selecting the appropriate defense.
TRAINER_KOICHI.proposed_crack: Flying pressures Passimian, Sirfetch'd and Scrafty, but Lucario is neutral to Flying/Psychic and weak to Fire/Ground/Fighting. Scrafty is Psychic-immune and fourfold Fairy-weak; exploit Choice locks without feeding Defiant.

TRAINER_JAIDEN.assessment: Ninjask begins beside Skuntank, so Baton Pass cannot directly select that already-active partner. Drapion can receive speed immediately; Skuntank requires a prior switch. Accelgor's full HP investment makes Final Gambit real. Preserve order and write the legal recipient logic.
TRAINER_JAIDEN.acceptance: Test Baton Pass excluding active Skuntank, Final Gambit into Ghost/protection and Unburden after Bug Gem.

TRAINER_ALIX.assessment: Specs Munkidori/Jynx combines immediate damage, Toxic Chain and sleep, then Musharna/Chimecho support. A poisoned target cannot also sleep, so independently scoring both lead actions can waste Jynx's turn. Preserve team with coordinated status allocation.
TRAINER_ALIX.acceptance: Test Toxic Chain triggering before Lovely Kiss, alternative targets, Steel immunity and Helping Hand versus healing.

TRAINER_PERRY.assessment: Toucannon/Unfezant uses Tailwind and high-pressure physical attacks; configured Tinted Lens Decidueye and Intimidate Staraptor diversify reserves. Decidueye is Grass/Ghost, not Flying, and resists Electric; the generic bird weakness prose is wrong.
TRAINER_PERRY.acceptance: Test Tailwind, Spirit Shackle trapping, Tinted Lens resistance multiplier and Decidueye's actual typing.
TRAINER_PERRY.proposed_crack: Rock/Electric pressure the Flying members, but Grass/Ghost Decidueye resists Electric and is neutral to Rock. Fire/Flying/Ghost/Dark/Ice pressure Decidueye; account for Tailwind and Intimidate when selecting physical answers.

TRAINER_CHESTER.assessment: Mandibuzz Tailwind supports Braviary, with Vileplume mitigation and Fearow pivoting behind. Unlike Rufflet's case, Braviary has Rock Slide that actually benefits from Sheer Force; preserve that ability. Brave Bird still recoils and does not receive that boost.
TRAINER_CHESTER.acceptance: Compare Sheer Force Rock Slide versus Brave Bird Life Orb/recoil behavior, Tailwind and Strength Sap into stat-drop immunity.

TRAINER_MAGIKARP_GUY.assessment: Actual leads are Ditto/Milotic, then deliberately weak Magikarp and utility Feebas before Mega Gyarados. Five members satisfy the party rule; preserve the comic identity while ensuring the AI uses the fish's best real options. The plan's order and dismissal of the first three are inaccurate.
TRAINER_MAGIKARP_GUY.acceptance: Test real lead order, Imposter targeting, Flail power at low HP and Hypnosis/Icy Wind utility before Mega Gyarados.

TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_2.assessment: Magnezone/Exploud coherently upgrades the reporter identity with Electroweb and Scrappy Hyper Voice; Chatot and Unfezant provide alternate Tailwind/physical offense. Preserve all four, with no need to give the pair a new unrelated theme.
TRAINER_GABBY_AND_TY_2.acceptance: Test Electroweb increasing Exploud's action order, Sturdy after Sitrus and Tailwind avoiding redundant recasts.

TRAINER_BRENT.assessment: Hitmontop's Fake Out/Wide Guard/Feint directly supports Volcarona; Durant and Yanmega provide physical Hustle and special Speed Boost reserves. This is an exemplary expert strategy on a casual trainer and should remain intact.
TRAINER_BRENT.acceptance: Test Feint opening a protected target for Heat Wave, Wide Guard priorities and setup versus immediate lethal pressure.

TRAINER_DONALD.assessment: Leavanny Electroweb and Galvantula pressure support Mega Heracross or Intimidate Vespiquen. Electroweb is an attack that hits Flying targets, not Sticky Web; the crack confuses two different mechanics. Preserve actual move and role.
TRAINER_DONALD.acceptance: Test Electroweb into Flying and Ground, Mega Skill Link multihit and Vespiquen Helping Hand support.
TRAINER_DONALD.proposed_crack: Fire/Flying pressure the Bugs according to typing. Electroweb can hit Flying targets; Ground immunity blocks its Electric damage and speed drop. Control speed or disrupt setup while respecting Mega Heracross's multihit pressure.

TRAINER_TAYLOR.assessment: Vivillon/Ribombee combines accurate powder with Sweet Veil-protected Quiver Dance; Araquanid offers Wide Guard and strong Water attacks, Pinsir Moxie physical offense. Preserve all four. Mental Herb answers one disruption but not powder immunity.
TRAINER_TAYLOR.acceptance: Test simultaneous Sweet Veil and powder rules, Pollen Puff healing versus damage, and Water Bubble Fire reduction on Araquanid.

TRAINER_DOUG.assessment: Masquerain/Ariados integrates Intimidate, Rage Powder and Web, with Lokix priority and Orbeetle screens. Web only affects subsequent grounded entries; redirection offers immediate support. Preserve this different bug puzzle rather than standardizing it to Tailwind.
TRAINER_DOUG.acceptance: Test priority Rage Powder, Web reserve value, Tinted Lens First Impression and screens by incoming damage category.

TRAINER_GREG.assessment: Ledian supplies screens/Tailwind for Escavalier, with Leavanny/Galvantula adding faster mixed offense. Escavalier's very low Speed is not automatically fixed by Tailwind; the main early payoff can be screens while speed benefits reserves. Preserve and calculate actual order.
TRAINER_GREG.acceptance: Test screen selection over pointless Tailwind against unreachable speed thresholds, then Tailwind benefiting the faster reserves.

TRAINER_KENT.assessment: Ninjask begins beside Pinsir, so the advertised direct pass requires Pinsir first returning to reserve. Vespiquen or Kilowattrel are immediate legal recipients. Keep the useful support options but make the recipient constraint explicit instead of forcing an illegal action.
TRAINER_KENT.acceptance: Test Baton Pass excluding active Pinsir, legal alternate recipients and subsequent Moxie Pinsir entry after a tactical switch.

TRAINER_JACKSON_1.assessment: Tapu Koko/Alolan Raichu has immediate terrain speed, Fan Rotom airborne offense and last-slot Tangrowth redirection. Configured Motor Drive Fan Rotom differs from ordinary Rotom; preserve its actual ability. Ground cannot hit Flying Rotom and Tangrowth resists it.
TRAINER_JACKSON_1.acceptance: Test terrain timing, Fan Rotom's Motor Drive and Tangrowth powder immunity/Regenerator ace entry.

TRAINER_CATHERINE_1.assessment: Castform/Noivern builds rain for accurate Hurricane; Hydration Goodra and Swift Swim Seismitoad cover bulky and fast special routes. Noivern's Dragon typing makes Electric neutral and rain Castform takes neutral Rock, so shared generic weaknesses need correction.
TRAINER_CATHERINE_1.acceptance: Test Forecast before damage, rain accuracy, Hydration status recovery and Seismitoad speed after weather replacement.
TRAINER_CATHERINE_1.proposed_crack: Electric pressures rain-form Castform but is neutral on Dragon/Flying Noivern; Rock pressures Noivern but is neutral on rain-form Castform. Ice/Fairy pressure the dragons, while Grass is fourfold effective on Seismitoad. Replacing rain changes several strengths at once.

TRAINER_PHIL.assessment: Staraptor/Farfetch'd combines Intimidate, anti-Intimidate and Feint, with Volt Absorb Kilowattrel and high-critical Unfezant as reserves. Kilowattrel is Electric-immune, so Electric cannot be advertised as universal flock coverage.
TRAINER_PHIL.acceptance: Test Defiant, Feint enabling partner attacks and Volt Absorb replacement into Electric pressure.
TRAINER_PHIL.proposed_crack: Rock pressures the aerial roster and Ice threatens several members, but Kilowattrel's Volt Absorb makes Electric unsafe against it. Avoid feeding Farfetch'd Defiant while accounting for Tailwind and Staraptor's Intimidate.

TRAINER_TAKASHI.assessment: Accelgor's Gem/Unburden and HP-based Final Gambit complement Weezing's burn/Taunt, with Protean Greninja and Sniper Drapion in reserve. Protean is once per entry; Final Gambit must assess target HP and immunity rather than treating sacrifice as always useful.
TRAINER_TAKASHI.acceptance: Test Final Gambit against Ghost, lower-HP and protected targets; Bug Gem consumption and Protean reset after U-turn.

TRAINER_CHRIS.assessment: Sharpedo/Gyarados is the actual lead, with Overqwil providing the second Intimidate and Whiscash an Electric-immune reserve. Overqwil is Dark/Poison, taking neutral Electric. Preserve four complete loadouts and rely on the shared floor to correct low offsets at live caps.
TRAINER_CHRIS.acceptance: Test both Intimidates versus Defiant/Amulet, Speed Boost/Dragon Dance and reserve immunity selection.
TRAINER_CHRIS.proposed_crack: Electric strongly threatens Gyarados and pressures Sharpedo, but is neutral on Dark/Poison Overqwil and ineffective on Whiscash. Grass strongly threatens Whiscash; Defiant and Clear Amulet can answer different aspects of the Intimidate plan.

TRAINER_RACHEL.assessment: Pelipper/Ludicolo opens eight-turn rain with Tailwind/Wide Guard, then Dry Skin Heliolisk or configured Lightning Rod Emolga. Electric is neutral on Ludicolo and is redirected by Emolga once present. Preserve this well-supported weather team.
TRAINER_RACHEL.acceptance: Test Damp Rock duration, Lightning Rod targeting, Dry Skin healing and Wide Guard against spread Electric.
TRAINER_RACHEL.proposed_crack: Electric strongly threatens Pelipper but is neutral on Ludicolo, and Emolga can redirect single-target Electric attacks. Flying/Bug/Poison pressure Ludicolo; Ground threatens Heliolisk but misses Emolga. Damp Rock makes rain last eight turns.

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_1.assessment: Golbat/Crawdaunt offers Taunt/pivot and Adaptability offense, with Prankster Liepard and Tentacruel as reserve support. Rapid Spin is conditional hazard removal; no Surf friendly fire is required. Preserve the four-team faction puzzle.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_1.acceptance: Test partner-aware Fake Out/Encore, Prankster Dark immunity and Crawdaunt priority under opposing terrain.

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_4.assessment: Walrein/Malamar pairs Icy Wind/Encore with Contrary Superpower; Flare Boost Gourgeist and Speed Boost Sharpedo give special and fast physical reserves. No Trick Room exists. Clear Amulet can prevent beneficial opponent stat-drop triggers of Contrary, but still blocks harmful effects; retain as authored with accurate modeling.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_4.acceptance: Test Contrary plus Clear Amulet ordering, Icy Wind speed and Flare Boost activation without a Room assumption.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_4.proposed_crack: Fighting/Electric pressure Walrein, Bug/Fairy pressure Malamar, and Ghost/Fire pressure Gourgeist. This team has no Trick Room; contest Icy Wind and Sharpedo's accumulated speed instead of waiting for an imaginary Room to expire.

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_5.assessment: Toxicroak Fake Out supports Technician Scizor setup, with physical Eelektross and Band Crawdaunt maintaining pressure. All-physical construction provides clear mitigation counterplay while retaining immunities and priority. Slowness alone never grants an opponent two actions.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_5.acceptance: Test Fake Out/Swords Dance coordination, Technician Bullet Punch and Levitate bypass; compare opposing two-slot targeting without false extra turns.

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_2.assessment: Pelipper's rain/Wide Guard supports Iron Defense Ferrothorn, followed by Sniper Inteleon or bulky Swift Swim Ludicolo. Rain reduces Fire damage to Ferrothorn without eliminating its weakness. Preserve this coherent weather/defense composition.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_2.acceptance: Test rain Fire modifier, Body Press after Iron Defense, Snipe Shot bypass and Swift Swim at actual bulky investment.

TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_3.assessment: Mightyena Howl supports Golisopod and physical reserves; Alolan Muk has Curse/Gluttony and Qwilfish provides another Intimidate. Fighting is neutral on Dark/Poison Muk. Preserve faction identity and conditional Emergency Exit action planning.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_3.acceptance: Test Howl on both allies, Sitrus/Emergency Exit order and Gluttony Figy Berry with Muk's nature.
TRAINER_GRUNT_WEATHER_INST_3.proposed_crack: Fighting pressures Mightyena but is neutral against Dark/Poison Alolan Muk, whose sole ordinary weakness is Ground. Electric/Rock pressure Golisopod; handle Intimidate and berry-backed sustain while respecting priority.

TRAINER_SHELLY_WEATHER_INSTITUTE.assessment: Alolan Ninetales/Empoleon combines Veil with Competitive offense; Unaware Clefable, Kingdra, Rotom and Mega Feraligatr provide support and finishers. Ninetales is neutral to Fighting, Clefable resists it, and Kingdra is neutral to Grass/Electric. Preserve team and correct the matchup guidance.
TRAINER_SHELLY_WEATHER_INSTITUTE.acceptance: Test Veil setup/removal and separate timers, Follow Me versus spread attacks, Unaware and Mega Feraligatr's configured ability.
TRAINER_SHELLY_WEATHER_INSTITUTE.proposed_crack: Remove Veil directly or prevent its setup. Steel strongly threatens Alolan Ninetales and pressures Clefable; Fighting is neutral on Ninetales and resisted by Clefable. Grass/Electric threaten Feraligatr but are neutral on Kingdra; choose coverage for each active pair.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_MUDKIP.assessment: Swellow/Manectric keeps the rival's signature lead; Breloom and Shiftry provide sleep/Fake Out, Mimikyu disruption and final Sceptile physical offense. Preserve the complete branch and its genuine final starter ace.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_MUDKIP.acceptance: Test Mudkip-player dispatch, Disguise/Mental Herb, Lightning Rod coverage and Sceptile last-slot release.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_TORCHIC.assessment: The Swampert variant adds Ludicolo's Fake Out/Icy Wind and retains Mimikyu disruption. Ground immunity and special support distinguish it from Sceptile's branch without changing the familiar lead. Preserve all six.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_TORCHIC.acceptance: Test Torchic-player dispatch, Swampert selection/ace timing and Ludicolo speed support against different target speeds.

TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_TREECKO.assessment: Camerupt contributes slow special Fire/Ground attacks while final Blaziken brings Speed Boost offense. The shared lead, Breloom and Mimikyu provide several setup-denial tools. Preserve both Fire members because their roles differ.
TRAINER_BRENDAN_ROUTE_119_TREECKO.acceptance: Test Treecko-player dispatch, Blaziken after Protect and Camerupt choice against physical mitigation.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_MUDKIP.assessment: May's Sceptile branch matches Brendan's complete six, including Shiftry and Mimikyu. Preserve parity and independently validate gender/story routing, since duplicate loadouts are intentional alternatives rather than separate repeated battles.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_MUDKIP.acceptance: Run May's Mudkip-player milestone and verify Shiftry Fake Out, Disguise and final Sceptile fields.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_TORCHIC.assessment: May's Swampert branch retains Ludicolo's special support and Mimikyu disruption. It is the same full battle puzzle through a different rival route, with exact order and loadouts preserved.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_TORCHIC.acceptance: Run May's Torchic-player milestone; check Icy Wind, Lightning Rod and Swampert's final-ace release.

TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_TREECKO.assessment: May's Blaziken branch keeps Camerupt's slow coverage and the shared Hoenn lead. The two Fire reserves are tactically distinct and no speculative coverage replacement is justified.
TRAINER_MAY_ROUTE_119_TREECKO.acceptance: Run May's Treecko-player milestone; compare the exact stats and Speed Boost behavior with Brendan's counterpart.

TRAINER_YASU.assessment: Crobat's actual utility is Taunt/Tailwind, not Haze. It supports Sniper Drapion, then sound Toxtricity or Levitate Weezing. Ground cannot hit Crobat or ordinary Levitate Weezing without bypass; preserve team and repair the plan/crack.
TRAINER_YASU.acceptance: Test actual Taunt move, Tailwind order, Sniper critical damage and Ground immunity on both relevant members.
TRAINER_YASU.proposed_crack: Electric/Rock pressure Crobat, while Ground threatens Drapion and especially Toxtricity. Crobat and Levitate Weezing normally avoid Ground. This team uses Taunt rather than Haze; Psychic pressures Toxtricity but cannot hit Dark-typed Drapion.
